digest.motivationZh: 慢时间尺度动力学相同的动量方法，在完整光滑强凸函数类上可能呈现不同的最坏收敛行为。二次函数上的加速并不足以保证整个函数类稳定，需要精确区分查询位置和参数调优的作用。明确稳定性边界与匹配上下界，可防止把连续流或二次情形结论直接移植到离散优化器。这是优化与数值分析理论，与用户的 LLM 加速器、KV 缓存及矩阵向量数据通路联系较弱。
digest.methodZh: 理论分析用有限滞后证书构造收敛上界，再用有限维目标上的螺旋混合或二次轨迹给出匹配下界。；梯度查询外推位置的半步边界；有限分离查询点的函数值/梯度不等式证书；跨迭代时域匹配的下界；临界参数层及最优首项常数分类；在完整函数类上给出精确距离收敛因子，并区分二次加速与一般强凸稳定性。

papers.title: Holographic Drag Force and the Entanglement Membrane: Geometric Reconstruction and Information Spreading
papers.abstract: A central question in holography is how different boundary observables encode and reconstruct the geometry of the gravitational dual. In this work, we uncover an exact geometric correspondence between two seemingly distinct aspects of strongly coupled dynamics: the dissipative drag force experienced by a moving heavy particle(quark) and the entanglement membrane governing the propagation of quantum information. We show that both constructions retain the same underlying structure of the geometry, leading to an invertible transformation between the finite-velocity drag force and the geometric membrane tension. This correspondence reveals that nonlinear momentum loss encodes detailed information about entanglement dynamics: the leading nonlinear correction determines the butterfly velocity, while higher-order terms successively probe the local geometry of the membrane near the horizon. We further connect this hierarchy to scalar pole-skipping, establishing an all-order relation between nonlinear dissipation and near-horizon spectral data. The shared geometric structure also has implications for quantum information recovery, with the quintic drag coefficient determining the leading dependence of information velocity on initial entanglement. Conversely, the complete information-velocity curve provides a reconstruction of the reduced bulk geometry along the physical interior membrane branch, complementing the exterior reconstruction from drag. We show that stochastic momentum broadening supplies the additional radial information needed to reconstruct the complete exterior metric up to an overall scale. Our results thus reveal how dissipation, entanglement dynamics, and spectral properties provide complementary access to holographic geometry, establishing a unified framework for understanding the geometric information encoded in distinct boundary observables.

papers.title: Hybrid Newton-BFGS high-index saddle dynamics for accelerating saddle-point searches
papers.abstract: We propose a hybrid Newton-BFGS high-index saddle dynamics (HiSD) method for accelerating saddle-point searches. The method constructs a Newton correction on the unstable subspace from the available negative eigenpairs, while BFGS updates based on projected secant information approximate the inverse Hessian on the stable subspace. By combining Newton and quasi-Newton corrections, the method incorporates curvature information in both subspaces while preserving the ascent-descent structure of HiSD. Accounting for the evolving stable subspaces, we establish local $Q$-superlinear convergence of the full-memory version near nondegenerate saddle points under suitable assumptions. We further develop a limited-memory version for large-scale problems and provide fixed-step and line search strategies. Numerical experiments show local convergence behavior consistent with the theory and demonstrate acceleration on ill-conditioned problems and degenerate saddle manifolds in neural-network loss landscapes. The method also supports efficient upward and downward saddle searches for a liquid crystal model, further illustrating its broad applicability to saddle-point computation.

papers.title: Euler--Lagrange Flow Monotonicity for the Radon Transform
papers.abstract: We present a new gradient-like flow that targets critical points of the inequality for the planar Radon transform $\mathcal{R}$ proven by Oberlin and Stein, partially answering a question of Christ, who gave a complete characterisation of the extremisers of the inequality via rearrangement methods. We show that for non-negative radial initial data near the extremiser manifold, solutions to the flow exist globally and there exists a rescaled subsequence of the flow that converges to a critical point of the Radon functional $\|\mathcal{R} f\|_3/\|f\|_{3/2}$ locally in $L^{3/2}(\mathbb{R}^2)$. We also obtain a quantitative result for the rate of decay of critical points, which complements a result of Christ arXiv:1106.0719 in the special case of radial functions. We prove a novel localised smoothing estimate for the operator $\mathcal{R}^*[(\mathcal{R}\cdot)^2]$ restricted to radial functions. This approach is complementary to that of Christ and provides a robust framework for studying extremal problems associated to Radon-like operators.

papers.title: Unified transform method for nonautonomous linear evolution equations: rigorous analysis and qualitative theory
papers.abstract: Established herein is the rigorous extension of the celebrated Fokas unified transform method for linear evolution PDE with time-dependent coefficients. As illustrative examples, considered below and rigorously analysed in detail are non-homogeneous initial-boundary-value problems, formulated on the half-line, for the heat equation and the modified heat (also widely known as Barenblatt's pseudo-parabolic) equation with reaction terms and temporally varying coefficients. Solution formulae are derived formally via suitable implementation of the UTM, and rigorously verified a posteriori, in the classical sense. The latter task relies on complex-analytic tools and careful interpretation of the obtained integral representations. The explicit solutions established here are then used for investigating qualitative properties. These include regularity, boundary behavior near the axes of the domain as well as long-range and eventual periodicity asymptotics. Notably, smoothness of the solution up to the boundaries depends on compatibility conditions between initial, boundary and forcing data, into which interjected now are initial values of the coefficients. Further results pertaining to solution uniqueness, analyticity and controllability of the addressed problems are thence deduced in light of the preceding qualitative theory.

papers.title: Mn-deficient Ni-Mn-Ga alloys: phase transitions, magnetic properties, and disappearance of martensitic transformation
papers.abstract: Composition gradients formed during directional solidification are generally considered undesirable in Ni-Mn-Ga magnetic shape-memory alloys. However, these gradients offer a highly effective platform for systematically investigating composition-property relationships under identical growth and heat-treatment conditions. To exploit this approach, one Mn-deficient and two near-stoichiometric Ni-Mn-Ga oligocrystals were grown by optical zone remelting and characterized by X-ray fluorescence mapping, optical microscopy, X-ray diffraction, low-field magnetic measurements, and vibrating-sample magnetometry. The ingots contained elongated grains and axial compositional gradients, primarily associated with the redistribution of Mn and Ga, whereas Ni remained relatively uniformly distributed. The martensitic and premartensitic transformation temperatures generally increased with increasing Mn content. Neither transformation was detected between 10 and 400 K in specimens containing 20.5-22.0 at.% Mn, all of which had $e/a < 7.40$. In contrast, both transformations were observed in the investigated specimens containing at least 22.1 at.% ($e/a \geq 7.46$). This abrupt change may indicate a possible electron-concentration threshold for the occurrence of these transformations. Saturation magnetization increased with Mn content up to 25.8 at.%, reaching 96.9 A m$^2$/kg at 10 K and 71.2 A m$^2$/kg at 300 K. Post-growth annealing increased the transition temperatures and changed the low-field magnetic response. The results indicate that composition-gradient oligocrystals serve as an effective platform for investigating the relationships between composition, structure, and magnetic properties in Ni-Mn-Ga alloys with the same processing history.

papers.title: Probing quasiperiodic spectral accessibility with a finite-rate quantum Otto cycle
papers.abstract: Quasiperiodic systems combine sharply different spectral and localisation regimes with a dense hierarchy of dynamical time scales. We show that a finite-rate quantum Otto cycle can use this structure as a thermodynamic probe, revealing which parts of the spectrum become dynamically accessible and thermodynamically relevant during a driven transformation. For a generalised Aubry-André-Harper chain, the resulting response is not determined by the static quasiperiodic regime alone: extended, near-critical, and crossing protocols do not exhibit universal ordering of work fluctuations. Instead, the statistics reflect transition pathways that are simultaneously dynamically coupled, thermally occupied, and energetically significant. The same spectral accessibility separates thermodynamic recovery from microscopic adiabatic recovery. Positive mean work can reappear while the population transfer dynamics remain strongly nonadiabatic because finite-rate population transfer is redistributed toward energetically less costly channels rather than suppressed. The full work distribution reveals a further separation, with a finite rate window in which positive-work cycles form a majority although the mean work remains negative. This behaviour persists in finite-size analysis. A thermally weighted spectral susceptibility connects these effects to a distributed hierarchy of dynamically active spectral regions rather than to a single minimum-gap bottleneck. Finite thermal contacts preserve this picture while introducing a second time scale and intercycle memory. Quantum Otto cycles can therefore provide a fluctuation-resolved thermodynamic probe of quasiperiodic spectral accessibility, complementary to direct spectroscopic and eigenstate-resolved diagnostics.

papers.title: Measurements of transverse kinematic imbalance in muon neutrino charged-current interactions on argon with a single proton and no pions in the final state with SBND
papers.abstract: This letter presents the first neutrino-argon cross-section measurement from the Short-Baseline Near Detector (SBND) at the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory. We report the nominal flux-averaged single-differential cross sections of muon neutrino charged-current interactions on argon with a single proton and no pions in the final state as functions of the transverse kinematic imbalance variables. Using a subset of Run~1 data corresponding to $8.8\times10^{19}$ protons-on-target, we select 12,804 signal candidates with a purity of 91%. The extracted cross sections discriminate strongly among event-generator predictions, owing to the high statistics and the design of the analysis. Among the compared models, none successfully describes all three variables, with the largest discrepancies in the transverse missing momentum variable. These results set new benchmarks for neutrino-argon interaction modeling, which is crucial for high-precision measurements at current and future accelerator neutrino experiments.

papers.title: StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Quantization reduces the memory and bandwidth demands of large language model (LLM) inference but can degrade accuracy; offloading higher-precision data can instead stall generation. We introduce StrataFlux, a framework that challenges this tradeoff by recovering accuracy lost to low-bit weight and key-value (KV) cache quantization while retaining quantization's memory and speed advantages. StrataFlux co-designs refinement representation, selection, and delivery to make host RAM and solid-state drives useful sources of additional precision. Its selective precision streaming reduces transfer volume, overlaps delivery with computation, and reuses fetched precision across decoding steps so generation need not wait for every transfer. We evaluate 2-4-bit weights and 2-3-bit KV-cache on dedicated GPUs and unified-memory platforms. For 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights, StrataFlux reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 9.46 to 8.40 while maintaining 95.4% of the quantized base's throughput on RTX 5090. With 2-bit weights and KV, StrataFlux raises Qwen3-8B's AIME 2024/2025 accuracy from 11.0% to 47.1% at unchanged GPU memory use. At 128K context, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with 3-bit weights and 2-bit KV achieves comparable perplexity and speed to vLLM's 4-bit AWQ weights and 8-bit KV on RTX 5090, using approximately half the GPU memory. These results show that GPU-resident precision need not set the accuracy ceiling, nor offloading-tier latency dictate decoding speed.

digest.summaryZh: StrataFlux 把低比特权重和 KV 的补充精度放到主存或 SSD，按重要性选择并异步获取，跨解码步复用以恢复质量。它把量化表示与分层存储调度结合，是本轮最贴近 LLM 内存体系结构的工作。
digest.motivationZh: 极低比特量化会损害推理质量，而同步取回高精度数据又可能阻塞解码。固定精度与完整高精度卸载将表示和放置分开设计，难以兼顾容量、精度及传输时延。低比特权重与长上下文 KV 的容量收益，只有在传输不吞噬吞吐时才具有部署价值。直接关联低比特 LLM、KV 缓存、异构内存和软硬件协同，应优先研究。
digest.methodZh: 让低比特基底常驻快速内存，选择性传输少量权重与 KV 补充信息，并通过提前获取、延后修正及缓存扩大重叠窗口。；权重按激活大小选择通道，使用拟合后的残差修正；KV 按常驻低比特键的注意力选择词元，用嵌套量化补充比特；提前选择或延后加入权重修正，复用跨步缓存；独立 GPU 从锁页主存读取补充数据；统一内存平台由 SSD 经共享 RAM 缓存供 GPU 使用。两条路径应分别评估。；将补充精度编码、选择和异步交付联合设计，使额外精度不必在原投影运算窗口内同步到达。
digest.experimentsZh: 评估 2–4 比特权重与 2–3 比特 KV，覆盖独立 GPU 和统一内存；使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-8B 等模型。对照不加修正的量化基底，并在长上下文配置对照 vLLM 的 W4 AWQ 与 8 比特 KV。RTX 5090 上，2 比特 Llama 的困惑度 9.46→8.40，保留量化基底 95.4% 吞吐；Qwen W2KV2 的 AIME 2024/2025 准确率 11.0%→47.1%。128K 下 W3KV2 以约一半 GPU 显存获得与上述 vLLM 配置接近的困惑度和速度。GPU 显存减少不等于总存储减少；收益依赖通道及词元可预测性、缓存复用和后台传输。需按平台检验精度、带宽与缺失等待策略，不能把 95.4% 吞吐理解为加速。

papers.title: Amplifying Latency and Cost of LLM Inference via Rowhammer Attack
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high inference efficiency using optimized GPU kernels generated by just-in-time (JIT) compilation frameworks such as Triton. Triton compiles GPU kernels through an MLIR/LLVM-based pipeline. We investigate whether a Rowhammer-induced bit-flip in the CPU's DRAM can degrade GPU-based LLM inference performance while preserving output correctness. We present LLVMhammer, the first Rowhammer attack that causes LLM inference slowdown by inducing a bit-flip in Triton's compilation pipeline. A bit-flip in a performance-critical optimization pass causes Triton to generate a functionally identical but suboptimal GPU kernel. Since Triton caches the generated kernel on disk, a single successful bit-flip causes persistent slowdown across subsequent inference executions. Triton's target-independent stages are shared across GPU vendors, which makes our attack GPU vendor-agnostic. To identify exploitable bit-flip locations without manual inspection, we build Karnage, a tool that isolates useful bit-flip locations in Triton's target-independent compilation pipeline. We evaluate LLVMHammer across a diverse set of LLMs, including Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Deepseek-llm-7B-chat, across NVIDIA RTX 4090 and AMD RX 7900 XTX GPUs. LLVMhammer increases inference latency of an LLM inference server running on a single GPU by 4-16\%, which, in turn, can translate into additional annual operating costs at the scale of multi-GPU deployments. We further show that LLVMhammer can also corrupt LLM outputs across different GPU vendors, reducing BERTScore to as low as 25\%, illustrating the broader security implications of bit-flips in Triton's compilation pipeline.

papers.title: VitaLLM: A Versatile, Ultra-Compact Ternary LLM Accelerator with Dependency-Aware Scheduling
papers.abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) on resource-constrained edge devices faces critical bottlenecks in memory bandwidth and power consumption. While ternary quantization (e.g., BitNet b1.58) significantly reduces model size, its direct deployment on general-purpose hardware is hindered by workload imbalance, bandwidth-bound decoding, and strict data dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{VitaLLM}, a hardware-software co-designed accelerator tailored for efficient ternary LLM inference. We introduce a heterogeneous \textbf{Dual-Core Compute Strategy} that synergizes specialized TINT-Cores for massive ternary projections with a unified BoothFlex-Core for mixed-precision attention, ensuring high utilization across both compute-bound prefill and bandwidth-bound decode stages. Furthermore, we develop a \textbf{Leading One Prediction (LOP)} mechanism to prune redundant Key-Value (KV) cache fetches and a \textbf{Dependency-Aware Scheduling} framework to hide the latency of nonlinear operations. Implemented in TSMC 16nm technology, VitaLLM achieves a decoding throughput of 70.70 tokens/s within an ultra-compact area of 0.223 mm$^2$ and a power consumption of 65.97 mW. The design delivers a superior Figure of Merit (FOM) of 17.4 TOPS/mm$^2$/W, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art accelerators. Finally, we explore an extended bit-serial design (BoothFlex-BS) to demonstrate the architecture's adaptability for precision-agile inference.

digest.summaryZh: VitaLLM 是面向边缘设备的三值 LLM 推理加速器，针对 BitNet b1.58 等 ternary LLM 的带宽、功耗和依赖瓶颈做软硬件协同设计。它用双核计算策略覆盖三值投影与混合精度 attention，并通过 KV cache 剪枝和依赖感知调度提升利用率。
digest.motivationZh: 资源受限设备部署 LLM 受限于内存带宽和功耗；三值量化能降低模型大小，但在通用硬件上仍会遇到 workload 不均衡、decode 带宽瓶颈和严格数据依赖。
digest.methodZh: VitaLLM 采用 TINT-Core 处理大规模三值投影，BoothFlex-Core 处理混合精度 attention。Leading One Prediction 用于剪枝冗余 KV cache fetch，Dependency-Aware Scheduling 用于隐藏非线性操作延迟。

papers.title: Sim-FA: A GPGPU Simulator Framework for Fine-Grained FlashAttention Pipeline Analysis
papers.abstract: To efficiently support Large Language Models (LLMs), modern GPGPU architectures have introduced new features and programming paradigms, such as warp specialization. These features enable temporal overlap between the producer and consumer, as well as between matrix multiplication and activation function operations, substantially improving performance. To conduct effective AI infrastructure and computer architecture research, cycle-accurate simulators that support these new features, together with analytical models that faithfully capture workload characteristics, are essential. However, existing academic tools provide limited support for these emerging requirements. Existing cycle-accurate simulators do not incorporate new NVIDIA GPU features, such as the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), in a timely manner. Moreover, existing analytical models can misestimate DRAM traffic under certain configurations. In this paper, we build a simulation pipeline from FlashAttention-3 kernel instrumentation to cycle-accurate simulation. The simulator achieves a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 5.7\% and a maximum absolute percentage error of 12.7\% against H800. We also provide a theoretical analysis of FlashAttention-3 and explain why existing analytical models can produce inaccurate traffic estimates.

papers.title: Exploring the Efficiency of 3D-Stacked AI Chip Architecture for LLM Inference with Voxel
papers.abstract: To overcome the well-known memory bottleneck of AI chips, 3D stacked architectures that employ advanced packaging technology with high-density through-silicon vias (TSVs) pins have proven to be a promising solution. The 3D-stacked AI chip enables ultra-high memory bandwidth between compute and memory by stacking numerous DRAM banks atop many AI cores in a distributed manner. However, it is not easy to explore the efficiency of the 3D-stacked AI chip, due to its unique distributed nature. And we need to carefully consider multiple intertwined factors that range from upper-level computing paradigm to machine learning (ML) compiler optimizations, and to the underlying hardware architecture. In this paper, we develop Voxel, a fast and compiler-aware end-to-end simulation framework to facilitate exploring the efficiency of 3D-stacked AI chips for large language model (LLM) inference. Voxel enables the software/hardware co-exploration by employing a programming interface that allows ML compilers to customize the model execution plans. After validating the results of Voxel with an emulator on real silicon, we thoroughly examine the impact and correlation of different aspects of 3D-stacked AI chips, including state-of-the-art compute paradigms, tile-to-core mapping, tensor-to-bank mapping, NoC topologies and link bandwidth, DRAM bank bandwidth, per-core SRAM capacity, and energy/thermal constraints. Our findings disclose that the end-to-end efficiency of a 3D stacked AI chip not only is determined by the cooperative function of these factors, but also significantly depends on the mappings from tiles to AI core and DRAM banks. We report our findings throughout the paper, with the expectation that they will shed light on the development of the 3D-stacked AI chip ecosystem. We will open source Voxel and our study results for public research.

digest.summaryZh: CXL-NDP 在 CXL 内存设备内采用位平面布局、按精度读取及无损压缩，降低权重和 KV 的传输压力。本文按队列标题对应的 v1 阅读，报告的端到端增益需结合特定精度与容量设置理解。
digest.motivationZh: 长上下文 LLM 权重和 KV 溢出 HBM 后，CXL 链路及设备 DRAM 带宽成为瓶颈。仅靠容量扩展及应用层量化，仍难使设备内访问流量随精度缩减。有效带宽决定分层内存的吞吐收益与可支持的上下文长度。直接关联 KV cache、CXL 内存层次与近数据处理，建议精读设备布局和评估假设。
digest.methodZh: 在标准 CXL.mem 接口后重排位平面，结合通道化 KV 去相关与透明编解码，按请求精度取数。精度分区逻辑地址；位平面布局与选择读取；KV 通道重排与指数差分；设备内无损压缩及重组流水线。v1 设计在 CXL 链路与设备 DRAM 之间插入控制流水线，读取指定平面并返回正常数据格式。将动态精度支持和无损压缩整合到设备内部表示，而保持标准内存协议。
digest.experimentsZh: v1 IV-A 描述单 H100、LLaMA 3.1 70B、80GB HBM 与 256GB CXL 层；另有 DRAMSim3 和 RTL 综合评估。端到端比较按字节访问的传统 CXL 方案；压缩比较不带 KV 聚类去相关的位平面布局。v1 在 65k 上下文、5 bit/weight 设置报告吞吐提高 43%，可用上下文延长 87%；BookSum KV 占用下降 46.9%。保留队列旧标题并采用 v1，不混用已更名 TRACE 的 v3 数据；仿真、综合与端到端设置应分别看待，无生产部署复现。

papers.title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
papers.abstract: Apple Silicon is among the most widely used platforms for local LLM inference, yet nearly all inference optimizations are designed and validated on server-class NVIDIA GPUs under batched serving workloads. Which optimizations retain their benefits when moved to Apple Silicon, and what determines their applicability? We evaluate four optimization families: KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization. Experiments span four Apple machines under a common single-request decode workload, with matched RTX 4090 comparisons where possible. KV-cache pruning can reach up to 1.75 times end-to-end throughput on Apple but can reduce throughput on desktop NVIDIA GPUs. Under the common benchmark, all evaluated speculative decoding methods reduce throughput on Apple, despite reported 2-6 times gains on server GPUs. CUDA kernel designs transfer only partially: public Metal lacks asynchronous copy, and batch-one decode makes several serving-oriented mechanisms inapplicable, although transferable components yield up to 1.20 times decode throughput. Quantization gains vary by machine. Across four families, a reported speedup is not a portable property of a technique alone but a joint function of technique, runtime, hardware contract, and workload regime.

papers.title: Extreme Compression of Per-Layer Embeddings via Cross-Layer Latent Vector Quantization
papers.abstract: Scaling embedding capacity alongside Transformer computation is an emerging trend in language models. This trend makes high compression rates increasingly useful. Hence, we study extreme compression of Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE), which follow this trend and account for 35.2% of the parameters of Gemma 4 E4B. At such rates, conventional quantizers give each token-layer vector its own code of only a few bytes. We instead develop OPTIC (Output-Path-fitted, Token-shared Indexed Codes), which stores one quantized code tuple per token and decodes it at every layer with a layer-specific affine decoder. Codes and decoders are fitted to the PLE output path rather than to the stored vectors. At about $100\times$ PLE compression of bfloat16 (BF16) E4B, OPTIC retains an aggregate 97.8% of the uncompressed model's performance across seven benchmarks, whereas product quantization, the strongest of six conventional baselines, retains 66.3%. At $594\times$ and $1,002\times$ PLE compression of BF16 E4B, OPTIC retains 90.5% and 84.1%. On the official E4B release with 4-bit linear weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16), OPTIC retains 96.9% at about $100\times$ PLE compression. During inference at about $100\times$ PLE compression, BF16 E4B uses 29.7% less GPU memory than with uncompressed PLE at the same key-value cache size, while running at most 0.40% slower.

papers.title: RIFT: KV Cache Compression for Draft Models with Complementary Compressibility Training
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding is a popular decode acceleration method. As such, it is particularly relevant to long-output generation, which requires an increasingly large KV cache. KV cache compression offers a way to constrain costs in long-context drafting. However, compression methods that focus on prefill information can lose relevance as the output length grows. We term this phenomenon decode staleness and show that it degrades draft model accuracy under selection-based KV cache compression. We introduce RIFT, a family of selection-based KV cache compression strategies that balance prefill information and recent generated tokens. We show that refreshing the KV cache selection during token generation significantly improves the drafter's quality at the cost of additional decode latency. To alleviate the refresh costs, we propose an adaptive KV refresh strategy that reduces the number of score calculations while retaining the drafter's quality. We further demonstrate how a compressibility-driven drafter training phase, based on sparse attention masks, can improve the drafter's quality under a compressed KV cache. Combined with compressibility training, RIFT enables Qwen3.5-4B, drafting for Qwen3.5-122B, to retain over 98% of its full-cache acceptance length on 32K-token inputs, 4K-token outputs, and an 8K-token KV cache budget.

papers.title: Scenario-aware Adaptive Neuromorphic Intelligence for multimodal sensor fusion
papers.abstract: Multisensory Physical AI systems operating in isolated conditions must make timely and reliable decisions within strict energy and hardware budgets. In this context, the present analytical study investigates the feasibility of reliable multimodal sensor fusion using a neuromorphic approach based on memristor-based Integrate-and-Fire neuron circuits driven by aggressively compressed representations of sensory information. Rather than relying on fixed processing and learning parameters, the proposed framework introduces scenario-dependent adaptability into individual stages of the neuromorphic decision-making pipeline, including sensor-data compression, nonlinear spike encoding, reliability assessment, and memristive learning-forgetting dynamics. By coupling multiple sensor inputs through adaptive memristive synapses, the framework investigates how reliable and correlated observations can strengthen learned associations, while weak or obsolete relationships gradually decay through nonlinear forgetting. The resulting neuronal responses are evaluated across ten representative driving scenarios derived from the NuScenes dataset by comparing their encoded output patterns with predefined synthetic ground-truth codes representing the expected actuator responses. The simulations demonstrate that scenario-adaptive activity-vector sizing achieves a 61.5% reduction in retained sensory information, while improving mean bit-wise agreement from approximately 55% to 61.2% compared with a fixed maximum-resolution configuration. These findings highlight the potential of introducing scenario-aware adaptability directly into the building blocks of a neuromorphic system, providing a foundation for future hardware implementations that could significantly transform the capabilities of Physical AI systems operating under stringent resource and environmental constraints.

papers.title: CAMP: Context-Aware Mapping and Placement for LLMs on 3D-IMC Arrays
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) incur severe memory-access overheads due to the cost of loading large weight matrices and key-value (KV) caches. Analog In-Memory Computing (AIMC) is an emerging solution that enables computation directly on static weights stored in memory, substantially reducing energy and latency. 3D-IMC further stacks memory arrays into vertical tiers, increasing capacity but revealing a new challenge: how weights are placed in memory determines which matrix-vector multiplications (MVMs) can execute concurrently, affecting latency and throughput. The concurrency aspect of 3D-IMC weight-mapping remains underexplored in the literature, leading to sub-optimal utilization of compute resources on 3D-IMC chips. In this context we propose CAMP (Context-Aware Mapping and Placement), an inference-context-aware weight mapping algorithm for 3D-IMC-based LLM accelerators. CAMP captures the potential resource contention resulting from the architecture, targeted network, and runtime context in a conflict matrix, enabling throughput-optimized weight mapping. This mapping is refined through a profiling-driven feedback loop that efficiently prunes the search space and returns optimized mappings within practical runtimes. CAMP is an offline, software-based solution requiring no hardware changes and improving 3D-IMC compute utilization from 42.4% to 60.3%, delivering up to 2.0x higher 3D-IMC throughput and 1.74x higher end-to-end throughput over state-of-the-art mapping algorithms.

papers.title: FIGFLEX: A Mixed-Precision FP-INT GEMM Accelerator Co-Designed with Low-Bit LLM Quantization
papers.abstract: Weight-only quantization keeps LLM activations in floating point and stores weights as low-bit integers, turning the dominant workload into floating-point-integer (FP-INT) general matrix multiplication. Recent quantizers reach a 2-3-bit average with mixed precision, but hardware has not kept pace: GPUs dequantize weights to FP16 before the tensor-core multiply-accumulate, and bit-parallel FP-INT accelerators run at a single weight precision, so fewer bits save memory but not computation. In this paper, we present FIGFLEX, an algorithm-hardware co-designed mixed-precision accelerator whose bit-parallel datapath scales throughput as precision falls. FIGFLEX contributes (1) a shift-add, radix-4 reformulation of FP-INT multiplication that fuses the multiply-accumulate into a unified, precision-flexible partial-product reduction and roughly halves the partial products, together with a novel INT3 optimization that reclaims the idle datapath radix-4 leaves at that precision; and (2) a mixed-precision quantizer that assigns each channel group its bit-width according to the error GPTQ cannot compensate, with a per-input-channel column scaling whose power-of-two normalization keeps the scaled activations out of the FP16 subnormal range, so that the quantized model maps directly onto FIGFLEX's datapath with the same accuracy as on a GPU. On LLaMA-2-7B, FIGFLEX attains 5.85 and 8.77 WikiText-2 perplexity at 3- and 2-bit average precision, lower than GPTQ, AWQ, SliM-LLM, AMQ, and QuIP# (without fine-tuning), while delivering 1.56x and 1.42x higher whole-chip throughput per area on the linear GEMMs of a 3-bit mixed-precision model than AxCore and FIGLUT, respectively.

papers.title: OSAQ: Outlier Self-Absorption for Accurate Low-bit LLM Quantization
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities. However, their massive parameter scale leads to significant resource consumption and latency during inference. Post-training weight-only quantization offers a promising solution by reducing model size and accelerating token generation through alleviating the memory-bound issue. Nevertheless, the presence of inherent systematic outliers in weights continues to be a major obstacle. While existing methods, such as scaling and rotation, attempt to address this issue, the performance remains unsatisfactory. In this paper, we propose Outlier Self-Absorption Quantization (OSAQ), which performs additive weight suppression guided by the second-order low-rank property for low-bit weight-only quantization of LLMs. Specifically, we observe that the Hessian exhibits low-rank consistency across different inputs, with certain directions consistently showing vanishing curvature. Leveraging this property, we identify a stable null space of the Hessian and then construct an additive weight transformation by linearly combining the vectors within this null space, thereby suppressing weight outliers without affecting the task loss. This additive transformation can be absorbed into the weights offline, requiring no inter-layer transformations and introducing no inference overhead. Moreover, the construction is efficiently achieved by a closed-form solution, without resource-intensive training or iterative procedures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OSAQ effectively suppresses outliers and enhances low-bit quantization performance. For instance, in 2-bit quantization, OSAQ, when integrated with GPTQ, achieves over 40% lower perplexity compared to vanilla GPTQ.

digest.summaryZh: OSAQ 面向 LLM 低比特 weight-only 量化中的系统性 outlier，利用 Hessian 在不同输入上的低秩一致性寻找稳定零空间，并构造可离线吸收到权重中的加性变换，降低 outlier 对 2-bit 等量化精度的破坏。
digest.motivationZh: LLM 推理受参数规模、显存占用和 token 生成延迟限制，weight-only 量化能缓解 memory-bound 问题；但权重中的系统性 outlier 会让 scaling 或 rotation 等已有方法在低比特场景下精度不足，影响部署可用性。
digest.methodZh: OSAQ 将低比特量化中的 outlier 抑制建模为 Hessian 低秩零空间内的加性权重变换：先利用 Hessian 在不同输入上曲率消失方向的一致性识别稳定 null space，再线性组合这些方向构造闭式解，离线吸收到权重中，不增加推理时层间变换或训练迭代。
digest.experimentsZh: 摘要称进行了 extensive experiments，OSAQ 能抑制 outlier 并提升低比特量化表现；具体例子是在 2-bit 量化中，与 GPTQ 结合后相较 vanilla GPTQ perplexity 降低超过 40%。摘要未披露模型规模、数据集、更多基线和端到端延迟。

papers.title: Efficient Training on Multiple Consumer GPUs with RoundPipe
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on consumer-grade GPUs is highly cost-effective, yet constrained by limited GPU memory and slow PCIe interconnects. Pipeline parallelism combined with CPU offloading mitigates these hardware bottlenecks by reducing communication overhead. However, existing PP schedules suffer from an inherent limitation termed the weight binding issue. Binding uneven model stages (e.g., the LM head is large) to GPUs limits the pipeline's throughput to that of the GPU with the heaviest load, leading to severe pipeline bubbles. In this paper, we propose RoundPipe, a novel pipeline schedule that breaks the weight binding constraint on consumer GPU servers. RoundPipe treats GPUs as a pool of stateless execution workers and dynamically dispatches computation stages across devices in a round-robin manner, achieving a near-zero-bubble pipeline. To ensure training correctness and system efficiency, RoundPipe integrates a priority-aware transfer scheduling engine, a fine-grained distributed event-based synchronization protocol, and an automated layer partitioning algorithm. Evaluations on an 8$\times$ RTX 4090 server demonstrate that RoundPipe achieves 1.48--2.16$\times$ speedups over state-of-the-art baselines when fine-tuning 1.7B to 32B models. Remarkably, RoundPipe enables LoRA fine-tuning of the Qwen3-235B model with 31K sequence length on a single server. RoundPipe is publicly available as an open-source Python library with comprehensive documentation.

papers.title: Rotation Is Token-Blind: A Structural Criterion for Post-Training Quantization of Feed-Forward Geometry Transformers
papers.abstract: Feed-forward 3D models use Transformers to predict camera poses, depth, and structure in one pass, avoiding iterative multi-view optimization. Long sequences and deep attention incur high compute and memory costs, motivating Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) for deployment. Existing PTQ methods mainly suppress channel-wise outliers by smoothing or orthogonal rotation. Geometry Transformers introduce a different challenge: heterogeneous token types share one activation quantization grid. A few special tokens may exert high leverage over global outputs and be updated by only a subset of blocks. Token-blind transforms, which apply the same transformation to every token, reduce overall quantization error but cannot remove differentiated degradation across token types. We propose QMapAnything, a structure-aware PTQ framework. We cast floating-point-preserving rotation and smoothing as a token-blind reparameterization group, and prove that they yield common-mode gains while leaving relative token SNR unchanged. We introduce a statistic $Γ$ that combines a special token's quantization disadvantage and output leverage to predict whether differentiated bias correction is needed beyond rotation. Experiments on geometric benchmarks show that W4A8 closely matches full-precision performance. Under W8A8, peak memory falls by $2.2$--$3.1\times$ versus FP32, with up to $3.1\times$ speedup on real hardware. These results provide a principled and efficient approach to deploying feed-forward 3D reconstruction models in resource-constrained edges.

papers.title: StreamIndex: Memory-Bounded Compressed Sparse Attention via Streaming Top-k
papers.abstract: DeepSeek-V3.2 and V4 introduce Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA): a lightning indexer (a learned scoring projection over compressed keys) scores them, the top-k are selected per query, and a sparse attention kernel reads only those. Public CSA implementations materialize a [B, S, H_I, T] FP32 score tensor before the top-k reduction. With H_I=64 indexer heads and the V4-Flash compression ratio m=4, that intermediate is 256 GB at sequence length S=65,536, exceeding any single-GPU high-bandwidth-memory (HBM) budget. We present StreamIndex, a Triton implementation of the CSA pipeline whose central component is a chunked partition-merge top-k driver that never materializes the full intermediate. On synthetic-but-realistic V4-shaped inputs at the indexer-step (layer) level on a single NVIDIA H200, the materialize path runs out of memory (OOMs) at S=65,536 with V4-Flash dimensions; StreamIndex runs the same indexer to S=1,048,576 with 6.21 GB peak HBM, a 32x regime extension. Set-overlap recall against the materialize ground truth is bit-exact at small S where both fit; across three 5-point design-space sweeps (chunk size, key-tile size, top-k), mean recall rounds to 1.0000 with min recall at least 0.9980 in every cell. The chunked driver composes with TileLang's pipelined attention kernel: at S=262,144 with V4-Flash dimensions, the materialize indexer paired with TileLang attention OOMs while the chunked indexer paired with the same attention runs in 1.97 s at 18.56 GB peak. Our contribution targets the indexer step; we make no claim of a faster attention kernel or of real-checkpoint end-to-end behavior. Code: https://github.com/RightNow-AI/StreamIndex.

digest.summaryZh: StreamIndex 针对 DeepSeek CSA 中索引器先物化巨大 FP32 score tensor 的 HBM 爆炸问题，实现 Triton chunked partition-merge top-k，使压缩稀疏注意力索引阶段不再生成完整中间张量，并可与 TileLang attention kernel 组合。
digest.motivationZh: Compressed Sparse Attention 通过 indexer 选择 top-k compressed keys 来减少注意力读取，但公开实现会先物化 [B,S,H_I,T] FP32 score tensor；在 V4-Flash 形状、S=65,536、H_I=64、m=4 时中间张量达 256GB，超过单 GPU HBM，阻断长上下文部署。
digest.methodZh: StreamIndex 用 Triton 实现 CSA pipeline 的 streaming top-k：核心是 chunked partition-merge top-k driver，按块计算和合并候选，避免全量 score tensor；其目标是索引器步骤的内存有界化，并与 TileLang 的流水线 attention kernel 组合，而不是重新设计更快的 attention kernel。
digest.experimentsZh: 摘要披露在单 NVIDIA H200 的 V4-shaped 合成但现实形状输入上，物化路径在 S=65,536 OOM，StreamIndex 可跑到 S=1,048,576 且峰值 HBM 6.21GB，扩展 32x；小 S 下 top-k set overlap 与物化 ground truth bit-exact，三组 5 点 sweep 的 mean recall 为 1.0000、min recall 至少 0.9980；S=262,144 时与 TileLang attention 组合用 18.56GB、1.97s 跑通。

papers.title: GistRank: Gist-Compressed Listwise Ranking with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become a powerful tool for listwise relevance ranking, which can improve web search by comparing retrieved passages jointly. However, processing every candidate verbatim and generating a permutation autoregressively can make inference costly, every candidate must be serialized verbatim into the prompt and the input therefore grows linearly with both the number and the length of the passages. While sliding-window ranking handles context limits through repeated re-encoding of overlapping blocks, hard compression techniques sacrifice the fine-grained details required for accurate discriminative judgment. To better understand and mitigate this trade-off, we conduct a comprehensive study of soft compression for LLM-based listwise ranking. Our findings reveal that a vanilla gist representation is ill-suited to ranking for two reasons: strictly causal encoding weakens how thoroughly each gist token absorbs its passage, and the representation is never trained to expose the relative-preference structure that separates closely competing candidates. To this end, we propose GistRank, a three-stage training framework that equips a large language model with gist-compressed passage representations by learning faithful gist tokens under a semi-bidirectional attention scheme, instilling discriminative comparison through pairwise training, and adapting the model to the listwise objective. GistRank collapses each passage into only $K{=}4$ gist tokens, this gives 14$\times$ speedups over one-shot full-text ranking while reaching 59.17 average nDCG@10 over TREC DL19/20 and five BEIR subsets within 0.89 of the strongest full-context baseline. Overall, GistRank provides an effective means to enhance efficiency for searches in real-world environments.

digest.motivationZh: 列表式 LLM 排序需重复编码大量候选全文，输入和生成成本高。滑窗反复处理重叠内容，硬压缩又容易丢失区分相近候选的细节。排序质量与请求延迟之间的权衡直接影响检索服务效率。与压缩表示和高效推理相关，可跟踪工作负载变化；计算核心设计关联为间接。

papers.title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
papers.abstract: LLM pruning must preserve quality while meeting hardware- and workload-specific constraints on latency, throughput, and memory. Existing pruning workflows often target parameter counts, requiring practitioners to manually select model sizes that meet latency, throughput, and GPU memory limits. However, parameter count alone does not predict these metrics, which depend on the model architecture, workload, hardware, and serving engine. We introduce AutoCompress, a hardware-guided compression framework that directly incorporates such constraints into differentiable architecture search. AutoCompress jointly optimizes global and per-layer structure to produce heterogeneous architectures, guided by serving-engine cost models validated against end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory measurements. We evaluate AutoCompress on long-context local coding, batched datacenter serving, and latency-sensitive in-game interaction. Compared to the state-of-the-art Minitron pruning framework, AutoCompress improves average accuracy across eight benchmarks by 6.57, 2.35, and 0.57 percentage points on RTX 5070, RTX 5080, and H100, respectively. AutoCompress also compresses Nemotron 3.5 Super from 120B to 74B parameters for single-B200 BF16 serving at 128K context, retaining 95% of its mean benchmark score.

papers.title: Unifying Sparse Attention with Hierarchical Memory for Scalable Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Long-context LLM serving is bottlenecked by the cost of attending over ever-growing KV caches. Dynamic sparse attention promises relief by accessing only a small, query-dependent subset of the KV state per decoding step and extending the KV storage to CPU memory. In practice, however, these algorithmic savings rarely translate into end-to-end system-level gains because sparse methods typically operate at different granularities and thus rely on ad hoc, per-algorithm implementations. At the same time, hierarchical KV storage introduces a new systems bottleneck: retrieving fine-grained, irregular KV subsets across the GPU-CPU boundary can easily erase the benefits of sparsity. We present SPIN, a sparse-attention-aware inference framework that co-designs the execution pipeline with hierarchical KV storage through three techniques: (1) a unified partition abstraction that maps different sparsity granularities onto a shared page-based KV substrate; (2) a locality-aware KV cache manager that dynamically sizes per-request HBM budgets and uses a GPU-friendly bucketed LRU policy to cut PCIe round-trips; and (3) a two-level hierarchical metadata layout sized to the active working set rather than the worst-case address space. Built on vLLM with three representative sparse attention algorithms, SPIN delivers 1.66-5.66x higher end-to-end throughput and 7-9x lower TTFT than vLLM, and reduces TPOT by up to 58% over the original sparse-attention implementations.

digest.summaryZh: SPIN 面向长上下文 LLM serving，将动态稀疏注意力和分层 KV 存储统一到一个推理框架中。它通过 page-based KV 抽象、局部性感知 cache 管理和两级元数据布局，减少 GPU-CPU 之间不规则 KV 访问带来的系统开销。
digest.motivationZh: 长上下文 serving 的瓶颈在于不断增长的 KV cache。动态稀疏注意力理论上能减少访问量，但算法粒度不同和 GPU-CPU 分层存储的不规则访问，常会抵消端到端收益。
digest.methodZh: SPIN 在 vLLM 上实现统一 partition abstraction，将不同稀疏粒度映射到共享 page-based KV substrate；locality-aware KV cache manager 动态配置 HBM budget，并用 GPU-friendly bucketed LRU 减少 PCIe 往返；两级元数据布局按活跃工作集缩放。
digest.experimentsZh: 在 vLLM 和三种代表性稀疏注意力算法上，SPIN 端到端吞吐提升 1.66-5.66x，TTFT 降低 7-9x，并相比原始稀疏注意力实现最多降低 58% TPOT。

papers.title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

digest.summaryZh: dLLM-KVQ 将扩散语言模型的缓存复用误差纳入 KV 量化设计：重建揭示轨迹用于校准，并按行为和注意力指标保留部分高精度 K。现有评测主要证明任务分数，不能视为低比特内核加速。
digest.motivationZh: 扩散模型揭示 token 后双向表示变化，复用缓存已偏离完整重算。自回归 KV 量化默认前缀状态精确，不能充分刻画复用误差与量化误差叠加。直接最小化缓存重建误差可能无法保持去噪过程中的注意力行为。与低比特 KV、注意力误差和缓存策略直接相关，适合作为量化校准及行为指标参考。
digest.methodZh: TRACE 从问答样本重建合法揭示轨迹，再逐层选择高精度 K 保留策略。轨迹重建与校准；注意力KL及输出行为诊断；逐层K保留策略；标准低比特V量化。实验使用 H200；低比特路径采用量化-反量化模拟，未据此证明真实打包缓存或专用内核吞吐收益。校准状态对齐扩散揭示过程，并按任务行为决定高精度 K 预算，而非只减小重建误差。
digest.experimentsZh: LLaDA 与 Dream 在 GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH、MBPP 评测，覆盖 prefix/dual 缓存和 4/2 bit。同缓存接口下比较 KIVI、KVQuant；无缓存为原始推理参照，cache-only 才是量化直接参照。LLaDA 的 2-bit prefix 平均分为 44.38，KIVI 为 43.62、KVQuant 为 41.45，未量化缓存为 45.08；不同任务并非全部优于基线。QDQ 精度模拟不代表真实显存占用或端到端加速；高精度保留需计入有效位宽，缓存复用仍有独立误差。

papers.title: GPU-Resident Speculative Decoding for In-Browser LLM Inference with WebGPU
papers.abstract: WebGPU enables private, offline LLM inference inside web pages, but browser dispatch, inter-process communication, synchronous readback and single-token kernels slow decoding and make conventional speculative decoding inefficient. We present a WebGPU runtime that addresses these browser-specific costs. Deterministic small-batch integer kernels accelerate multi-token verification while preserving exact agreement with greedy decoding in the same quantized runtime. A GPU-resident loop performs drafting, verification, acceptance and KV-cache maintenance without a per-token CPU decision. A draft-free context-mixing drafter reuses page content, conversation history and session memory, while a device-aware controller adapts the speculation width and the submission window to measured costs. Across seven models from 0.5B to 8B parameters, 11 tasks and three client GPUs, our runtime decodes 3.5 to 5.4$\times$ faster than WebLLM on a laptop GPU, 4.8 to 6.2$\times$ faster on an integrated GPU and 4.8 to 8.6$\times$ faster on a workstation GPU. The GPU-resident loop and speculation contribute a further 1.8 to 3.2$\times$ over the optimized kernels on the workstation. Outputs match the quantized greedy decoding of the runtime exactly, and the mean GSM8K accuracy matches that of WebLLM. Optional draft heads raise the peak speedup to 10.2$\times$, while session memory provides additional gains without downloading extra weights.

digest.motivationZh: 浏览器验证、跨进程派发和同步回读使逐 token 解码成本高。传统投机解码增加起草派发和多 token 验证，弱客户端上可能反而变慢。减少 CPU-GPU 往返对低批量本地推理和交互延迟尤其重要。直接关联推理运行时、控制与 KV 调度，可借鉴 GPU 驻留执行；并非矩阵核心硬件实测。
digest.methodZh: 用确定性小批量整数内核支持多 token 验证，以 GPU 驻留循环执行接受决策和缓存维护。整数验证内核；GPU驻留控制循环；基于网页及历史的起草；设备感知投机宽度与提交窗口。浏览器 WebGPU/WGSL 执行，不需每 token CPU 接受决策；评测含 GTX1650、集显 Vega 与 RTX PRO5000。联合优化浏览器特有的派发、回读和验证成本，而非直接移植服务器投机流程。
digest.experimentsZh: 七个 0.5B–8B 模型、11 项任务与三类客户端 GPU；Chrome 中测量逐 token 延迟和输出质量。主比较 WebLLM，另含 Transformers.js、LlamaWeb 及自身 Greedy/GPU Loop 消融；与 WebLLM 比较使用相同已完成提示子集。相对 WebLLM 加速范围为 3.5–8.6 倍；输出严格一致的参照是本运行时量化贪心解码，不能扩大为与 BF16 或 WebLLM 逐 token 相同。WebLLM 与本方法的激活类型、缩放格式不完全相同，且长提示失败导致完成子集偏短；整体加速不可归因于投机单一因素。

papers.title: Deployment-Efficient Short-Term Load Forecasting in AI Data Centers via Sequence-to-Point Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract: Accurately forecasting the bursty and non-stationary power demand of AI data centers has become increasingly important, as abrupt workload-driven variations at the GPU-node level can affect real-time operational efficiency, power management, and grid-data center coordination. However, high-capacity forecasting models are often difficult to deploy at scale because of their memory and latency requirements, while lightweight predictors may fail to capture short-horizon temporal dynamics. To address this accuracy-deployment tradeoff, this paper proposes a deployment-efficient knowledge distillation framework for short-term load forecasting in AI data centers. The proposed framework first trains a high-capacity sequence teacher model for multi-step load trajectory prediction, where residual learning is used to improve robustness under non-stationary operating conditions. A lightweight point-wise student model is then developed for low-latency rolling inference using a compact neural network architecture. To transfer temporal knowledge from the teacher to the student, a sequence-to-point distillation strategy is introduced by aligning near-term predictive behavior and temporally pooled representations. Case studies on the MIT Supercloud dataset demonstrate that the proposed student model improves forecasting accuracy over recent deep learning baselines while reducing the deployment footprint by over 10x in parameter memory and model size.

digest.summaryZh: NOVA 结合更密 DRAM 与双层近存处理，将低算强度任务映射至外围层、高算强度任务映射至基底层，并协同支持 GQA、SSM 和 MoE。评估为模型与周期模拟，不能当作已流片性能。
digest.motivationZh: 混合 GQA、SSM、MoE 的算术强度差异大，同时权重和状态容量需求增加。单一近存执行层难覆盖冷热专家与不同算子的带宽计算比，传统 DRAM 还面临密度限制。统一支持混合负载需要容量、带宽、非线性与矩阵执行共同设计。与混合注意力和计算单元协同高度相关，可重点精读 GEMV/softmax 交叠及跨层分工。
digest.methodZh: 以 4F² VCT 和 POC 外围结构构建双层 NMP，通过独立带宽路径覆盖宽算术强度范围。外围层银行级BAPU；BGPU非线性与在线softmax；基底层Base-PU；双层并行及冷热专家分工。BAPU 完成状态更新与 GEMV，BGPU 做激活、累加和 softmax；GQA 采用分块与双 tile 交叠，基底层负责输出更新。复用外围逻辑层避免占用存储阵列，将混合算子执行与新 DRAM 堆叠技术联合设计。
digest.experimentsZh: BF16 下评测 Nemotron3-Nano/Super、Falcon-H1R 和 Qwen3，使用基于 Ramulator2 的周期级模拟与 H100 配套 HBM4 模型。比较 H100、AttAcc、Duplex、PIMBA；不支持的算子回退 GPU，NOVA 与 Duplex 的 TSV 配置和其他基线不同。摘要报告平均吞吐为 GPU 的 4.5 倍、端到端延迟下降 69.8%、能效为 5 倍；这些是所设模型和仿真配置下的汇总。预填充和未卸载操作仍在 GPU；采用新工艺密度和更宽通路假设，需单独拆解技术增益与架构收益，非量产实测。

papers.title: ELAS: Efficient Pre-Training of Low-Rank Large Language Models via 2:4 Activation Sparsity
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities, but their immense computational demands during training remain a critical bottleneck for widespread adoption. Low-rank training has received attention in recent years due to its ability to significantly reduce training memory usage. Meanwhile, applying 2:4 structured sparsity to weights and activations to leverage NVIDIA GPU support for 2:4 structured sparse format has become a promising direction. However, existing low-rank methods often leave activation matrices in full-rank, which dominates memory consumption and limits throughput during large-batch training. Furthermore, directly applying sparsity to weights often leads to non-negligible performance degradation. To achieve efficient pre-training of LLMs, this paper proposes ELAS: Efficient pre-training of Low-rank LLMs via 2:4 Activation Sparsity, a novel framework for low-rank models via 2:4 activation sparsity. ELAS applies squared ReLU activation functions to the feed-forward networks in low-rank models and implements 2:4 structured sparsity on the activations after the squared ReLU operation. We evaluated ELAS through pre-training experiments on LLaMA models ranging from 60M to 1B parameters. The results demonstrate that ELAS maintains performance with minimal degradation after applying 2:4 activation sparsity, while achieving training and inference acceleration. Moreover, ELAS reduces activation memory overhead, particularly with large batch sizes. Code is available at ELAS Repo.

papers.title: Budgeted LoRA: Distillation as Structured Compute Allocation for Efficient Inference
papers.abstract: We study distillation for large language models under explicit compute constraints, with the goal of producing student models that are not only cheaper to train, but structurally efficient at inference time. While prior approaches to parameter-efficient distillation, such as LoRA, reduce adaptation cost, they leave the dense backbone unchanged and therefore fail to deliver meaningful inference savings. We propose Budgeted LoRA, a distillation framework that treats model compression as a structured compute allocation problem. Instead of using a fixed student architecture, we introduce a global compute budget that sets the final target fraction of dense computation retained. Under this constraint, the model redistributes capacity across dense and low-rank pathways via (i) module-level dense retention coefficients, (ii) adaptive low-rank allocation, and (iii) post-training compression that selectively removes, approximates, or preserves dense components. This formulation yields a family of students controlled by a single budget dial. Empirically, Budgeted LoRA matches standard LoRA perplexity at a moderate budget with a 1.74x compressed-module speedup; at an aggressive budget it achieves a 4.05x speedup with moderate perplexity degradation, and it preserves higher accuracy on function-style in-context learning probes. These results suggest that, under compute-constrained distillation, retaining behavior is less about matching perplexity or removing more parameters than it is about controlling how dense computation is transferred to low-rank pathways.

papers.title: T3R: Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement Towards Efficient and Robust VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable end-to-end robot control, but inference is increasingly expensive. Each decision processes hundreds of visual tokens, often across multiple cameras, leading to substantial computation while allowing irrelevant background content to distract action prediction under distribution shift. We argue that these issues stem from two complementary forms of redundancy: many visual tokens are spatially irrelevant, while attention over the remaining tokens is often misallocated. Based on this observation, we propose T3R, a Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement framework. In the first stage, segmentation-guided token pruning removes irrelevant visual patches to reduce computation and eliminate distracting context. In the second stage, saliency-guided attention biasing reallocates attention toward action-critical visual regions and language instructions within the retained tokens. Together, pruning produces a cleaner candidate set, while attention biasing further emphasizes the most decision-relevant evidence, yielding a better accuracy-efficiency frontier than either stage alone. On LIBERO-Spatial, T3R removes 85% of scene-camera visual tokens while essentially matching the unpruned success rate, and improves success by up to 7 percentage points under out-of-distribution object-placement perturbations. The timing comparison attributes 7.8 ms per inference call to pruning and attention-bias application. As input resolution increases, LLM-forward profiling shows up to a 3.3x speedup over the unpruned baseline. Evaluations across LIBERO, SIMPLER, and RoboTwin with three VLA backbones show the strongest accuracy-efficiency benefits in multi-camera settings. These results demonstrate that training-free token refinement is a practical approach to efficient and robust VLA inference.

digest.summaryZh: T3R 先用分割引导裁剪 VLA 视觉词元，再对保留区域和指令施加显著性注意力偏置，无需训练即可减少冗余。成功率与时延收益依赖场景，LLM 前向最高加速不等于机器人闭环整体加速。
digest.motivationZh: 多相机 VLA 每次决策处理大量视觉词元，背景既增加计算，也可能干扰分布外动作预测。仅裁剪会丢失关键线索，仅调整注意力仍保留全量计算，二者需要互补处理。机器人控制同时受响应时间和动作可靠性约束，必须衡量裁剪的选择开销与成功率变化。属于多模态高效推理趋势，与词元稀疏和可变工作负载有关，硬件设计参考来自执行成本而非新电路。
digest.methodZh: 分割掩码在解码器入口筛选视觉 patch，保留原始位置编码，再用显著性偏置强调动作相关图像与指令。以任务相关图文相似度引导 EfficientTAM 分割。裁剪后沿用原 RoPE 位置，避免重新编号。使用 Integrated Gradients 识别指令显著词并在中间层加入注意力偏置。主要实验使用单张 L40S；分割异步更新并复用最近掩码，前处理与 LLM 前向需要分别统计。通过先清理候选词元再重分配注意力，结合空间冗余和注意力分配两种机制。
digest.experimentsZh: 在 LIBERO、SIMPLER 和 RoboTwin 上测试 OpenVLA-OFT、CogACT 与 π0.5，覆盖不同相机数量。比较未裁剪模型、TeamVLA、ADP 和 FastV，并区分原生工作点与强制高裁剪比例的设置。LIBERO-Spatial 裁剪 85% 场景相机词元时成功率 96%，未裁剪为 97%；调用时延 107.5→92.5 ms。摘要称分布外对象位置扰动下最高提升 7 个百分点，高分辨率 LLM 前向最高加速 3.3 倍。3.3 倍只针对 LLM 前向；7.8 ms 是比较中归因于裁剪和偏置的残差，并非单组件直接计时。分割异步运行，掩码失败仍会损害部分任务成功率。

papers.title: HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits distinct computational characteristics across its two phases: prefill is compute-intensive, whereas decode is more memory-bound. As a result, AI accelerators achieve varying levels of efficiency across the two phases. GPUs are well suited to prefill, but are often underutilized during decode. By contrast, NPUs can utilize their compute resources more effectively during decode. Motivated by this observation, we explore a heterogeneous architecture that integrates GPUs and NPUs, mapping prefill to GPUs and decode to NPUs to achieve high performance and efficiency. However, realizing such heterogeneous integration is challenging because LLM phase disaggregation requires KV cache transfer from prefill to decode (that is, from GPUs to NPUs), which is complicated by differences in inter-device communication mechanisms and KV cache tensor layouts. To address this, we propose HAWK, a transfer mechanism that enables rapid KV cache transfer across heterogeneous devices. HAWK establishes a remote direct memory access (RDMA) path for direct cross-device transfers while handling inter-device tensor layout discrepancies as part of the transfer process. In particular, HAWK allocates tensor-layout-aware RDMA buffers on the NPU side to match the target tensor layout. Leveraging these buffers, HAWK orchestrates data transfer from a conventional contiguous GPU RDMA buffer to the corresponding NPU buffers, allowing transferred tensors to be consumed directly without additional data rearrangement while maintaining transfer efficiency. We implement and evaluate HAWK on a system built with commercially available GPUs and NPUs, demonstrating performance within 7.88% of a GPU-only system under the same SLO constraints while achieving up to 1.26$\times$ higher power efficiency and 1.72$\times$ higher cost efficiency.

digest.summaryZh: GPU适合prefill而部分NPU更适合decode，但阶段分离要求跨异构设备传输KV，通信机制和张量布局不兼容。建立GPU到NPU的直接RDMA路径，在NPU侧分配目标布局感知缓冲区，将GPU连续缓冲区数据组织到对应NPU缓冲区，并把布局调整融入传输。摘要报告性能与GPU-only差距在7.88%以内，最高能效为其1.26倍、成本效率为其1.72倍。
digest.motivationZh: GPU适合prefill而部分NPU更适合decode，但阶段分离要求跨异构设备传输KV，通信机制和张量布局不兼容。主机中转和传后重排增加延迟，会抵消异构阶段分工的能效收益。系统必须让KV到达后可直接消费，才能把异构算力差异转化为服务收益。适合研究NPU数据布局、KV搬运和异构推理系统，属于系统层参考而非新计算核心。
digest.methodZh: 建立GPU到NPU的直接RDMA路径，在NPU侧分配目标布局感知缓冲区，将GPU连续缓冲区数据组织到对应NPU缓冲区，并把布局调整融入传输。在vLLM和Tenstorrent驱动栈中实现；GPU负责prefill、NPU负责decode，通过缓冲区映射消除额外传后重排。联合设计RDMA传输和目标张量布局，而非先完整传输再独立重排。
digest.experimentsZh: Llama 3.1 70B，TP=4；A100与Tenstorrent p150a分节点，200 Gbps InfiniBand；ShareGPT和LongBench负载。包括GPU-GPU主机中转与GPU-NPU主机中转配置，并与GPU-only系统在相同SLO约束下比较。摘要报告性能与GPU-only差距在7.88%以内，最高能效为其1.26倍、成本效率为其1.72倍。当前Tenstorrent模型栈限制实验主要使用一个70B模型；跨其他NPU布局的通用性不能视为均已实测。

papers.title: Edge intelligence for distributed acoustic sensing with ultracompact neural networks
papers.abstract: Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) transforms optical fibres into dense arrays of vibration sensors for continuous, long-range monitoring with high spatial resolution. Yet converting these large-scale measurements into actionable information with compact models that retain task performance remains challenging. Existing artificial-intelligence approaches are typically optimized for specific sensing environments and tasks, but their computational requirements can hinder deployment in compact, power-constrained field systems. Here, we introduce DAS-NanoNet, a framework that automatically constructs lightweight neural networks for different DAS scenarios and tasks, together with OmniDAS, an open benchmark spanning six representative environments. Using lightweight temporal operators tailored to DAS signals, an adaptive neural architecture search strategy derives a compact network for each scenario-task pairing. Across classification, localization, compression, and denoising tasks in diverse DAS applications, DAS-NanoNet consistently yields highly compact architectures. On a six-class dataset, it achieves 99.68% accuracy with only 1,391 trainable parameters, while delivering comparable or better performance with up to 18,098-fold fewer parameters than previously reported high-accuracy networks. Its compact architecture further enables edge deployment, achieving sub 9 $μ$s inference latency on the deployed hardware platform across different DAS applications. DAS-NanoNet provides a route towards edge intelligence for compact, low-power and real-time DAS systems through ultracompact networks tailored to individual sensing scenarios and tasks.

digest.summaryZh: DAS-NanoNet 通过面向场景与任务的神经架构搜索，为分布式光纤声学感知生成超小网络，并发布 OmniDAS 基准。FPGA 展示微秒级核心推理，但 ASIC 和光子平台仍属于未来方案或估算。
digest.motivationZh: 分布式光纤感知产生高采样率数据，现场设备难承受大模型的计算和存储需求。手工固定网络难兼顾不同感知场景的时域特征与容量需求，公共基准覆盖也有限。紧凑模型可降低权重、中间缓冲和边缘连续处理开销。属于边缘小网络及 FPGA 部署，可借鉴模型硬件适配；与 LLM 计算核心主线关联较弱。
digest.methodZh: 以轻量时域算子构建搜索空间，为每个场景与任务配对自动选择紧凑网络。OmniDAS多场景基准；时域算子搜索空间；自适应架构搜索；FPGA边缘部署。公开正文展示 FPGA 的 batch-one、16点输入部署；ASIC与光子计算仍是资源估算或未来方向。同时提供异构场景基准与按任务搜索的小网络，而非在统一大骨干上仅更新参数。
digest.experimentsZh: OmniDAS覆盖六种环境及分类、定位、压缩、降噪；FPGA验证工业光纤麦克风与周界安防。比较既有高准确率网络及 GPU 前向执行；参数对比与部署延迟不是同一评测口径。摘要六分类准确率99.68%、参数1391；两个FPGA核心延迟7.90和8.46微秒，预测与GPU分别98.77%和100%一致。FPGA核心时间不含完整感知链路，功耗为估计值；参数少不直接等于相同倍数端到端加速，不能宣称ASIC已实现。

papers.title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.

digest.summaryZh: 此 ICCAD 2025 3D-MoE 将三维近 DRAM 架构、SRAM 数字存内计算和专家分组结合，缓解多专家激活造成的容量与数据传输压力。已核验出版方摘要，全文评测细节尚不可读。
digest.motivationZh: 多专家激活提高模型能力，也加剧总权重容量与动态路由的数据搬运负担。传统存算组织难兼顾专家存储规模、不可预测访问和计算资源利用。权重布局与三维带宽共同决定多专家推理吞吐，不能只看峰值算力。与 MoE 近存架构及混合并行相关；需进一步核实具体芯片和公平基线才能用于定量比较。
digest.methodZh: 基于混合键合和 mini-TSV 的堆叠近DRAM结构，配合6T-SRAM数字存内计算宏和专家分组。3D近DRAM存储；6T-SRAM DCIM计算及权重缓冲；混合并行；Greedy-Swap Expert Grouping。出版方摘要说明DCIM宏兼作主要计算组件和权重缓冲，GSEG平衡tile组之间的参数放置；工艺和阵列规格未披露。把三维存储带宽、存内计算和专家放置联合用于多专家激活模型。
digest.experimentsZh: IEEE摘要称进行综合基准评测，但未列模型、精度、工艺、CPU/GPU型号或仿真方法。摘要仅明确CPU及GPU对照，具体配置及软件优化未披露。出版方摘要报告相对GPU吞吐68.89倍、能效47.11倍；由于配置不可核验，仅记录为作者宣称，不作通用收益。直接IEEE页面受JavaScript验证阻挡，仅核验出版方索引完整摘要；不能判断是否实测或同资源对比，注意与其他同名3D-MoE区分。

digest.summaryZh: KARAT 将检索式稀疏注意力的 KV 与索引键常驻通用近存节点，GPU保留投影与MoE，配合细粒度微批调度和上下文均衡。收益以满足延迟SLO的吞吐/TDP衡量，来自测量驱动的系统模拟。
digest.motivationZh: 百万上下文的稀疏注意力仍需保存完整KV和索引，挤占GPU容量并限制并发。低算强度GEMV专用PNM不能满足检索索引器的算强度和多样选择操作。只有同时满足容量、带宽和可编程计算要求，才能把容量扩展转化为服务吞吐。高度关联稀疏注意力KV路由、近存计算和服务调度，可精读索引器配置及核间通信。
digest.methodZh: 按操作类型分离GPU与KARAT，使所有读取KV和索引键的操作在近存端完成。LPDDR通用PNM设备；KV与索引本地共置；OFMS细粒度调度；CMR上下文均衡；功耗约束配置搜索。设计以GPU SM式通用核匹配索引扫描，节点保存请求的完整上下文，避免跨设备Gather；GPU执行投影和MoE。针对检索式稀疏注意力而非低强度GEMV定制算存比，并把硬件分工与微批调度共同优化。
digest.experimentsZh: 三种原生稀疏模型和真实Agent轨迹，8节点规模；基线64张H200，100ms P99 TBT约束；事件模拟由实机算子profiling驱动。GPU-only、HiSparse、Duplex、AttAcc和SPNM，另测Quest、STARC和MagicPIG；不支持操作回退GPU。原生稀疏注意力吞吐/TDP相对GPU为2.09–6.13倍；通用性不代表全场景最优，正文Quest和STARC上SPNM可更快，稠密注意力也非最佳。KARAT由H200 MIG近似设备算子并结合通信模拟，TDP不是实测整机能耗；主实验专家均匀采样，偏斜另做敏感性分析。

digest.summaryZh: HD-MoE针对三维近存系统中TP通信与EP负载偏斜的矛盾，离线联合平衡节点和链路，在线预测热点并预广播专家。公开代码可辅助复现，性能结果为所设网络及硬件模型下的映射评估。
digest.motivationZh: MoE动态路由使分布式近存节点负载不均，而张量切分又增加归约通信。仅平衡计算量忽略物理链路拥塞，固定映射难应对运行期热点。节点尾延迟和NoC争用共同限制token间隔，需联合放置与调度。与MoE软硬件协同、近存互连和负载均衡直接相关，可借鉴可复现映射框架。
digest.methodZh: 离线以优化模型决定专家切分并映射到mesh，在线按预测热点预广播专家和重分配token。节点负载与通信建模；线性规划放置；贝叶斯优化链路映射；热点预测；最优分块预广播。评估2D mesh中的分布式3D-NMP节点，通信通过离散事件模拟与解析模型估计；不是新增流片芯片展示。把逻辑负载平衡与物理链路映射分开求解，并以动态预广播补偿专家激活变化。
digest.experimentsZh: Mixtral-8x7B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Qwen2-57B，使用MT Bench及不同mesh、计算吞吐与链路带宽配置。TP、EP和仅计算平衡的Hybrid TP-EP，并消融节点、链路与动态策略。相对TP加速1.1–1.8倍，EP为1.1–1.5倍，混合基线为1.0–1.4倍；Mixtral在8×8 mesh上混合基线略优。依赖专家激活统计、近似通信模型和拓扑设定；离线搜索需数小时，不能假设任意模型分布下都优于混合并行。

papers.title: How Far Are We From On-Device VLM Inference? A Measurement Study on Edge NPUs
papers.abstract: Diverse optimizations spanning model architecture, inference runtime, and hardware acceleration have been proposed for on-device vision-language model (VLM) deployment on edge NPUs. Still, cross-layer coordination of VLM execution on edge NPUs remains largely underexplored. This paper presents an empirical measurement study across six representative VLMs, three real-world edge platforms, and ten multimodal benchmarks. Our evaluation drills down from end-to-end application-level latency and thermal traces down to low-level kernel-scale execution behaviors, challenging several widely held community assumptions. First, softmax dominates attention costs; even lookup-table-based softmax optimizations cannot eliminate pipeline bubbles that severely underutilize NPU matrix units. Second, theoretical speedups from linear attention vanish under real-NPU execution due to prohibitive tensor-rearrangement overhead. Third, no hardware backend universally dominates autoregressive decoding: attention-tensor-shaped parallelism dictates NPU efficiency and shifts the CPU-NPU performance balance. We further find task-specific Sweet Resolutions for VLMs, which deliver meaningful accuracy gains at only modest latency overhead. Complementing these findings, we provide actionable cross-layer recommendations for hardware architects, runtime developers, and model designers.

digest.motivationZh: 边缘VLM的视觉编码、预填充和解码跨越矩阵与非矩阵单元，端到端延迟及热限制突出。算法复杂度或峰值矩阵算力不足以预测实际NPU表现，跨层协调证据缺乏。softmax与重排引起的依赖会令矩阵单元空闲，影响低批量推理核心设计。直接支撑矩阵-向量分工、softmax微架构和混合注意力动机，建议最高优先级精读实测方法。
digest.methodZh: 通过多模型多平台逐层测量，从端到端延迟热轨迹下钻到内核分解、反汇编与roofline。CPU/GPU/NPU对照；注意力内核剖析；softmax指令分析；线性注意力重排分析；分辨率质量时延权衡。Hexagon中HMX执行QK与PV，HVX执行softmax及输出准备，Q6异步调度；RK3588以CNA矩阵和DPU查表softmax对照。揭示查表指数也不足以消除依赖气泡，并指出线性注意力理论收益会被布局变换抵消。
digest.experimentsZh: 六个VLM、十项多模态基准、OnePlus13T/Hexagon v79、Rhino Pi-X1/v73和Orange Pi5Plus/RKNPU。MNN的CPU/GPU路径与GenieX、RKLLM的NPU路径；需区分各平台支持的量化和框架设置。Hexagon v79的1024-token示例中softmax耗时1.87ms、整个FA内核2.76ms，HMX矩阵仅0.28ms；不能将此比例外推所有NPU。实测受设备、内核、量化和单请求设置限定；没有直接测量昇腾950，不可将Hexagon数字当作950结果。

papers.title: Bezier-Guided Adaptive Flow for Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract: Cross-domain sequential recommendation aims to alleviate data sparsity and cold-start problems by transferring useful preference knowledge across domains. However, users exhibit varying degrees of preference consistency across domains, while existing methods often rely on global alignment objectives or coarse-grained transfer strategies. Such approaches may introduce irrelevant information and provide limited flexibility in adapting semantic representations to individual user preferences. To address these challenges, we propose BGAFlow, a personalized framework that combines state-adaptive semantic evolution with user-specific transfer control. BGAFlow first establishes a shared semantic space through unified dual-domain pretraining with user profiles inferred by a large language model (LLM). Based on latent interest overlap, it then estimates a personalized horizon to determine the appropriate transfer extent for each user. To enable semantic adaptation, BGAFlow constructs a conditional Bezier curve as a geometric reference and learns a residual flow that progressively refines the trajectory based on intermediate preference states. The learned flow incorporates dynamic preference feedback to adjust transfer directions, while recommendation supervision and trajectory regularization encourage effective and smooth adaptation. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that BGAFlow consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the benefits of personalized transfer control and state-adaptive semantic evolution.

papers.title: ZeroRAG: Adaptive Semantic Peer Routing for Decentralized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a standard approach to enhance the reliability of large language model (LLM) outputs by retrieving documents relevant to a query and supplying them in the LLM prompt. Today's RAG systems collect, index, and serve these documents from centralized stores. In practice, however, documents are owned by organizations, devices, and individuals who cannot or will not surrender custody of them to a central party, e.g., because of privacy, copyright or regulatory compliance. Existing modern decentralized retrieval techniques either reintroduce a coordinating authority, or rely on a global data structure that requires continuous network-wide coordination (e.g., DHTs). We present ZeroRAG, a decentralized routing layer for document retrieval in RAG that performs semantic query routing across an overlay of peers with- out global data structures or centralized orchestration. Documents remain with the peers that own them, and each peer keeps only lightweight local state: a bounded set of neighbor advertisements and a cache of recently routed queries. Using these, ZeroRAG steers each query through a best-first walk that progressively rewires the overlay toward semantically relevant neighbors, so recall improves over time as the network self-organizes. We evaluate ZeroRAG using three real-world workloads and two decentralized baselines. We find that ZeroRAG outperforms baselines in terms of recall and required network messages, approaches the recall and LLM answer accuracy of a centralized document store, self-heals after catastrophic peer failures, and scales to 100 000 peers.

digest.summaryZh: ZeroRAG 以邻居语义广告和历史查询缓存构建自适应对等路由，让文档保留在所属节点，无需集中索引或全局结构。它通过查询驱动网络重连提高检索质量，属于分布式 RAG 系统而非处理器架构。
digest.motivationZh: 机构或个人可能无法集中交出文档，但 RAG 又需要跨所有者检索相关内容。现有去中心化方案常依赖协调者或持续维护全局结构，带来网络协调成本。在保留数据控制权的同时维持召回和可扩展性，是分布式 RAG 的关键约束。与 Agent/RAG 服务系统相关，但不直接优化 LLM 核心、KV 缓存或片上数据通路，宜作系统趋势阅读。
digest.methodZh: 每个节点仅保存有限邻居广告与近期查询，用语义最佳优先遍历寻找文档，并逐步重连到相关邻居。文档留在拥有者本地检索。以邻居广告和查询记忆产生语义转介。缓存和拓扑适应共同减少重复路由成本。评估使用事件驱动的对等网络模拟，文档嵌入在统一内存中保存引用；不能视为十万台实际设备部署。不用全局索引结构，通过有界本地状态和查询驱动的拓扑演化获得检索路由能力。
digest.experimentsZh: 工作负载为 AOL-IA、Amazon Electronics 与 PubMedQA；后者额外检验端到端 RAG 回答。去中心化对照为 Semantica 与 DHT-LSH，并用集中存储检索对照最终召回及回答质量。摘要报告召回与消息开销优于两类去中心化基线，接近集中存储的召回和回答准确率，并在节点大规模失效后恢复，模拟扩展到 100000 个节点；此处不补写未核对的提升比例。模拟中的消息和统一嵌入存储不等价于真实广域网的时延、带宽与隐私保证；重复类别查询可能有利于缓存和语义重连。

papers.title: Only Accepted Tokens Count: An Energy Accounting of Speculative Decoding Under Latency Targets
papers.abstract: Large language model serving is limited by facility power. Energy per token determines how many tokens a datacenter can serve, while a latency target bounds how quickly each user receives them. During decode, every weight is read from memory for every generated token. Batching amortizes this read across users but makes no individual user faster. Speculative decoding does: a drafter proposes several future tokens, and the target model verifies them in a single forward pass that reuses the same weight read. Because every drafted token must be verified whether or not it is accepted, the energy speculation saves depends on how many drafted tokens are accepted. This saving is hard to pin down. It varies across target models from different attention families and across drafting schemes, and it depends on the text being served. Every drafter we evaluate accepts fewer tokens on conversation than on code, and every trained drafter accepts fewer on Romansh, a low-resource language, than on English. We measure speculative decoding under production serving conditions (SGLang, CUDA graphs enabled) on H100 and H200 GPUs, at batch sizes up to 64 across 5 corpora. On dense models, verification, not drafting, dominates the energy cost. The saving shrinks as the batch grows, because batching has already shared the weight read that speculation would divide among the accepted tokens. At large batch sizes, block drafters push verification past the balance point between arithmetic and memory traffic into the compute-bound regime, where the saving becomes a loss, and a drafter with low acceptance raises energy per token. Meeting a tighter latency target with speculation then costs additional energy. Larger batches lower energy per token without speculation. Speculation adds to that saving only when acceptance is high, and on the model we tested it leaves little headroom for latency-preserving DVFS.

papers.title: KEET: Explaining Performance of GPU Kernels Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Performance profiles of GPU kernels generated by tools such as Nsight Compute are rich in detail but are often challenging to interpret. To achieve the best performance possible on a given GPU architecture, kernel developers need to spend significant time analyzing and comparing profiles in the tool's graphical interface to identify and understand kernel performance bottlenecks. Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in understanding complex data and generating natural language explanations. In this paper, we propose the Kernel Execution Explanation Toolkit (KEET), an LLM-based agentic framework for interpreting Nsight Compute profiles to generate useful and data-grounded natural language explanations of performance issues in GPU kernels, and suggestions for optimizations. We evaluate \toolname using several CUDA kernels of varying complexity on NVIDIA H100 GPUs. We find that the generated explanations, when provided as context, improve the quality of LLM code optimization and multiple-choice question answering in downstream tasks. We further demonstrate that the tool can be used to interpret performance data from large sets of profiles to improve the quality of optimization suggestions.

papers.title: UlaCache: Unified Logical Addressing for Sparse LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Long contexts increase the memory cost of the key-value (KV) cache in large language model (LLM) inference. Sparse attention reduces attention computation and memory traffic by selecting historical tokens, but the retained KV cache must remain available for later decoding steps. We present UlaCache, a KV cache management system built around a unified logical address space spanning GPU KV pools and optional CPU memory. Stable logical references let the inference engine allocate and select KV independently of physical placement. Common allocation and sparse-access interfaces support data-parallel (DP) and tensor-parallel (TP) attention. For distributed storage, local GPU buffers retain selected KV across decoding steps, so only missing entries require transfers. When CPU storage is enabled, Parallel Bucketed LRU (PB-LRU) manages a GPU pool shared across requests. It updates recency metadata and selects eviction victims in parallel. UlaCache transfers KV and then updates the address mappings. With speculative decoding enabled under matched CPU and GPU memory budgets, UlaCache achieves peak decoding throughput speedups of 1.16 $\times$ (DP) and 1.70 $\times$ (TP) on H200, and 1.73 $\times$ (DP) and 2.51 $\times$ (TP) on B300, compared with the state-of-the-art baseline.
