papers.title: RISK-KV: Quality-Aware Selective KV Cache Reconstruction for Distributed LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Request migration and interruption recovery in distributed large language model (LLM) inference rely on historical key-value (KV) caches. Retaining or transferring a complete cache incurs substantial state overhead, whereas replaying historical tokens requires additional computation. This paper proposes RISK-KV, a quality-aware method for selective historical KV reconstruction in pretrained models. RISK-KV uses exact KV states on both sides of a target layer and cross-layer ridge regression to predict the missing layer's attention-projection input; it then folds in the original model's KV projection matrices to reduce predictor storage. Reconstruction risk is measured by the change in negative log-likelihood (NLL) caused by actual reconstruction, and low-overhead topology search with quality gating selects the layer groups to reconstruct. Independent tests on three language models show that representative recovery configurations omit 18.2 percent to 33.3 percent of historical KV, with perplexity changes below 0.5 percent. In a local request-recovery experiment with a 512-token history, RISK-KV achieves a 1.51 to 3.31 times speedup over full Token Replay. These results indicate that selective KV reconstruction can reduce historical cache overhead with small changes in predictive quality and improve request-recovery efficiency under the evaluated deployment conditions.

papers.title: Coral: Cost-Efficient Multi-LLM Serving over Heterogeneous Cloud GPUs
papers.abstract: The usage of large language models (LLMs) has grown increasingly fragmented, with no single model dominating. Meanwhile, cloud providers offer a wide range of mid-tier and older-generation GPUs that enjoy better availability and deliver comparable performance per dollar to top-tier hardware. To efficiently harness these heterogeneous resources for serving multiple LLMs concurrently, we introduce Coral, an adaptive heterogeneity-aware multi-LLM serving system. The key idea behind Coral is to jointly optimize resource allocation and the serving strategy of each model replica across all models. To keep pace with shifting throughput demand and resource availability, Coral applies a lossless two-stage decomposition that preserves joint optimality while cutting online solve time from hours to tens of seconds. Our evaluation across 6 models and 20 GPU configurations shows that Coral reduces serving cost by up to 2.79$\times$ over the best baseline, and delivers up to 2.39$\times$ higher goodput under scarce resource availability.

papers.title: Design Conductor 2.0: An agent builds a TurboQuant inference accelerator in 80 hours
papers.abstract: Driven by a rapid co-evolution of both harness and underlying models, LLM agents are improving at a dizzying pace. In our prior work (performed in Dec. 2025), we introduced "Design Conductor" (or just "Conductor"), a system capable of building a 5-stage Linux-capable RISC-V CPU in 12 hours. In this work, we introduce an updated multi-agent harness powered by frontier models released in April 2026, which is able to handle 80x larger tasks, at higher quality, fully autonomously. Following a brief introduction, we examine 4 designs that the system produced autonomously, including "VerTQ", an LLM inference accelerator which hard-wires support for TurboQuant in a 240-cycle pipeline, starting from the TurboQuant arXiv paper. VerTQ includes heavy compute processing, with 5129 FP16/32 units; the design was mapped to an FPGA at 125 MHz and consumes 5.7 mm^2 in TSMC 16FF (8 attention pipes). We review the key new characteristics that enabled these results. Finally, we analyze Design Conductor's token usage and other empirical characteristics, including its limitations.

papers.title: Precision - Preserving Subtensor Inference for a 22B Joint Audio - Video Generator under a Fixed GPU Working Set
papers.abstract: Complete-block offloading reduces model residency but requires each transferred block to fit the GPU budget. We present Precision-Preserving Subtensor Inference (PSI), a fixed-arena runtime that combines sub-block weight streaming with separately managed intermediate state for the BF16 LTX-2.5 22B joint audio-video transformer. The contribution is a construction whose managed GPU footprint is determined by reusable pages, live state, and bounded workspace, together with controls that separate resource use, transport correctness, and numerical fidelity. Its partitioned operators preserve the dense real-arithmetic construction under stated assumptions. Across nine matched full-prompt cases on RTX A6000, modified PSI reduces sampled transformer-process peak memory from 8,578 to 360 MiB relative to official MATH, while mean time for the eleven transformer invocations rises from 247.11 to 349.00 s. Its managed arena is 80 MiB. Complete native generation and a complete-block FLASH path both succeed under a fixed 3 GiB available-memory cap. The matched A6000 comparison and separate DGX Spark service suite both achieve 100% success in complete audiovisual decoding. FFN reuse lowers mean block time by 4.0% with unchanged BF16 outputs; a fixed-arithmetic one-token transport control preserves all saved states bitwise. Targeted bias and attention changes improve local and one-token numerical comparisons, while mean endpoint error increases across nine full-prompt cases. The construction enables BF16 audiovisual inference with an explicit transformer-memory budget and makes numerical fidelity a separate, testable property of the implementation.

digest.summaryZh: PSI 用固定 GPU 区域、子张量权重流和独立主机状态日志执行 BF16 音视频 Transformer，显著压缩受管理工作集。它同时暴露时间与浮点误差代价，80 MiB 不代表完整模型生成只需同等显存。

digest.methodZh: 以两页可复用权重缓冲执行子张量算子，将中间状态单独记入主机日志，并用事件约束搬运及复用顺序。固定 arena 容纳活跃状态、工作区和权重页。按通道分块计算 FFN 并复用中间值。以独立控制实验区分传输正确性、浮点运算变化和媒体完成情况。面向 BF16 LTX-2.5 22B 的 CUDA 原型；arena 上界由活跃状态、工作区、两页和元数据决定，不包含主机内存或 CUDA 上下文等外部开销。用明确的存储合同和数值控制，将小工作集可执行性与精度保持分开检验。

papers.title: Should You Split Decode? Disaggregation Across Future Models and Accelerators
papers.abstract: For large language model (LLM) inference, prefill/decode disaggregation (P/D) is deployed in production to isolate phases with different resource demands. Attention/feed-forward network disaggregation (AFD) splits decode again, but adds communication, placement constraints, and another provisioned pool. We ask whether role-specific placement repays this cost as models and accelerator roadmaps change. Infrastructure is committed before future models and hardware can be benchmarked. We present SiliconForge, a calibrated model that varies the serving decomposition and hardware assignment independently. We compare P/D and P/D+AFD across four model directions, four accelerator classes anchored to current and announced parts, and two fabrics. We co-optimize each design using the same rules for pipeline overlap and the same power budget. Our main comparisons show no robust deployment-level AFD advantage in service-level objective (SLO) goodput per kW. Most nominal estimates favor P/D. The largest AFD lead comes from fitting one more prefill replica, not from a more efficient decode pool. AFD has a nominal lead in the KV-heavy (key-value) model direction when the co-located expert pool spans several small scale-up domains. Larger domains or a fast fabric for both designs weaken that lead. We therefore find that prefill provisioning, decode memory bandwidth, links, and pool granularity decide deployments more than the split alone. A fixed hardware assignment can lose its advantage as models, fabrics, hardware assumptions, and objectives change. Re-optimizing mappings and pool sizes on the same hardware cuts early commitment's median normalized goodput loss from 36% to 9%. We recommend adjustable mappings and pool sizes to let boundary and hardware choices follow model demands.

digest.summaryZh: SiliconForge 在共同功率预算下比较 P/D 与进一步拆分注意力和 FFN 的部署，发现 AFD 没有稳健的整体 goodput/kW 优势。研究强调内存带宽、互联、池粒度和映射可调性，并承认前瞻建模的验证限制。
digest.motivationZh: 把 decode 再拆为注意力和 FFN 池可能改善角色适配，却增加通信与资源池配置成本。单看某个 decode 池或固定硬件映射，不能回答未来模型下完整部署是否受益。系统需要在模型和芯片发布前决策，必须区分拆分收益与资源配置、通信和功率预算的影响。直接关联异构 LLM 加速器、KV 内存带宽、解码调度与软硬件协同，适合主线深读。
digest.methodZh: 将服务拆分边界与硬件角色分配独立建模，在相同重叠规则和功率上限下联合优化映射及池大小。比较四类模型发展方向、四类加速器和两种互联。把容量、带宽、通信与排队纳入 SLO goodput。对硬件规格区间和模型误差进行敏感性检查。加速器类别覆盖 GPU、脉动阵列、3D-DRAM 和 SRAM/dataflow，部分锚点为已宣布或预测规格；goodput/kW 使用额定功率，不是系统实测能耗。把拆分方式与硬件分配解耦，并通过重新优化和不确定性检验避免把某一固定映射的偶然优势当作普遍结论。
digest.experimentsZh: SiliconForge 校准模型用于前瞻设计比较，既比较完整部署也分析 decode；公开吞吐与比较对用于外部核对。主对照是 P/D 与 P/D+AFD，均按共同预算优化；统一服务仅在单独敏感性分析中作为有条件上界。主要比较没有形成稳健 AFD 优势，多数名义点偏向 P/D；KV 密集与较小扩展域时可能出现 AFD 名义领先。重新优化同一硬件的映射和池大小，使提前固定选择的中位归一化 goodput 损失从 36% 降至 9%。结果为模型预测；正文承认部分 SLO 前沿验证失败、绝对吞吐高估，且没有跨两类研究硬件的公开实测对。排队模型省略慢节点等影响，不能把名义排序当作新芯片实证。

papers.title: RangeGuard: Efficient, Bounded Approximate Error Correction for Reliable DNNs
papers.abstract: As DRAM scales in density and adopts 3D integration, raw fault rates increase and multi-bit errors are no longer rare. Such errors can severely impact Deep Neural Networks (DNNs): although DNNs tolerate small numerical perturbations, random bit flips can create extreme outliers that propagate and sharply degrade accuracy. Large Language Models (LLMs) are particularly vulnerable because attention, residual, and normalization layers can amplify and preserve a single corrupted activation across many layers, destabilizing inference. This paper introduces RangeGuard, a metadata-centric error-correcting framework that provides strong reliability and high efficiency based on bounded approximate correction. Instead of protecting raw bits, RangeGuard encodes compact Range Identifiers (RIDs) that capture the numerical range of each value. These compact metadata enable efficient use of limited redundancy and concentrate protection on range changes, which indicate harmful semantic deviations, while ignoring benign intra-range variations. Upon detecting a range change, RangeGuard restores the correct range and substitutes a representative value, ensuring that error magnitudes are bounded within the range. Based on RIDs, RangeGuard can tolerate 64+ flipped bits using only 16 bits of parity available in GPU memories without a noticeable accuracy loss. By introducing semantic range protection, RangeGuard enables reliable DNN execution even under frequent memory errors and tight redundancy budgets.

digest.summaryZh: RangeGuard 针对 DRAM 高密度和 3D 集成带来的多 bit 错误对 DNN/LLM 激活值的破坏，提出基于 Range Identifier 的 metadata-centric 纠错：保护数值范围而非原始 bit，将错误幅度限制在语义可接受范围。
digest.motivationZh: DRAM scaling 和 3D integration 会提高 raw fault rate，多 bit 错误可能在 DNN 中形成极端 outlier；LLM 的 attention、residual 和 normalization layers 会放大并保留单个损坏 activation，导致推理不稳定，因此传统逐 bit 保护在冗余有限时效率不足。
digest.methodZh: RangeGuard 用 compact Range Identifiers 编码每个值的数值范围，把有限 redundancy 集中用于检测和纠正 range changes；检测到范围变化后，恢复正确 range 并替换 representative value，从而保证 error magnitude bounded，而忽略 range 内的良性扰动。
digest.experimentsZh: 摘要披露基于 RIDs，RangeGuard 可在 GPU memories 可用 16 bits parity 的条件下容忍 64+ flipped bits，且没有明显 accuracy loss。摘要未披露具体 DNN/LLM 模型、错误注入方法、数据集、能耗/面积开销和与 ECC baseline 的完整对比。

papers.title: English Calibration Erodes Lithuanian in Expert-Pruned Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
papers.abstract: Expert pruning compresses Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models by removing the experts that a calibration set marks as unimportant. Studies of high-resource languages largely find that English calibration transfers well to other languages. We test this for Lithuanian: we pruned four MoE models with REAP, removing 25% or 50% of the experts with English, Lithuanian or mixed calibration, and evaluated both languages on reading comprehension, translation and language modelling. English calibration does not transfer to Lithuanian: at 25% pruning, English comprehension fell by a median of 1.7 points but Lithuanian by 21.4. The transfer is asymmetric. Lithuanian calibration removed most of the Lithuanian loss and never significantly hurt English comprehension, which was on average 2.5 points better than under English calibration; only English language modeling got slightly worse. Routing suggests why: in the last layers, Lithuanian sends 55-72% of its expert selections to just eight experts, against 19-39% for English, and English calibration removes some of these experts. Compressed models should be calibrated, and evaluated, in every language they must serve.

digest.summaryZh: 该研究发现用英语校准剪除 MoE 专家会严重损伤立陶宛语能力，低资源语言的重要专家可能被校准集误判。多语言压缩应按实际服务语言校准和评测，参数减少本身不代表质量均衡或实际加速。
digest.motivationZh: 专家剪枝依赖校准集的重要性估计，英语样本可能漏掉低资源语言需要的专家。高资源语言上的跨语言迁移结论未必覆盖立陶宛语等路由更集中的语言。压缩模型若只报告英语平均分，可能掩盖目标用户语言能力的大幅退化。与 MoE 压缩、专家访问局部性和校准分布有关，可为量化及专家缓存研究提供评测风险提示。
digest.methodZh: 固定 REAP 剪枝方法与比例，改变英语、立陶宛语及混合校准，比较双语任务和逐层专家路由。以路由门权重和专家输出范数构成显著性分数。在每层删除低分的25%或50%路由专家。比较阅读、翻译和语言建模，并分析末层集中访问。这是压缩与语言质量研究；共享专家、稠密层和每词元激活专家数不变，不能仅据删除专家比例推断计算加速。用受控校准语言对照揭示英语向低资源语言迁移的不对称性，并联系专家选择分布解释损失。
digest.experimentsZh: 四个 MoE 模型为 Qwen3-30B、Qwen3.6、Gemma 4 和 GLM-4.7-Flash；校准覆盖 Wikipedia 与 Europarl。比较未剪枝模型及英语、立陶宛语、50/50混合校准的同一 REAP 方法，非多种剪枝算法优劣排名。25%专家剪枝下英语阅读中位下降 1.7 个百分点，立陶宛语下降 21.4。立陶宛语校准消除大部分该语言损失，英语阅读平均比英语校准高 2.5 点；末层八个专家占立陶宛语选择的55–72%，英语为19–39%。证据针对所测模型、两语言与 REAP；不能推广为所有低资源语言定律。等token校准并非等文本量，未据本文报告硬件吞吐或能耗增益。

papers.title: KernelBench-X: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
papers.abstract: LLM-based Triton kernel generation has attracted significant interest, yet a fundamental empirical question remains unanswered: where does this capability break down, and why? We present KernelBench-X, a benchmark designed to answer this question through category-aware evaluation of correctness and hardware efficiency across 176 tasks in 15 categories. Our systematic comparison of five representative methods yields three main findings. First, task structure determines correctness more than method design. Category explains nearly three times more variance in semantic correctness than method (9.4% vs 3.3% explained deviance), and 72% of Fusion tasks fail across all five methods while Math tasks are solved consistently. Second, iterative refinement improves correctness, but not performance. Across GEAK iterations, compile rate rises from 52.3% to 68.8% while average speedup declines from $1.58\times$ to $1.44\times$; newly rescued kernels consistently underperform persistently correct ones ($1.16\times$ vs $1.58\times$ speedup in round~0$\to$1). Third, correctness does not imply efficiency. 46.6% of correct kernels are slower than the PyTorch eager baseline, and cross-hardware speedup variance reaches $21.4\times$. Besides, quantization remains completely unsolved (0/30 successes) despite non-trivial compilation rates, revealing systematic misunderstanding of numerical computation contracts rather than surface-level syntax errors. These findings suggest that future progress depends on handling global coordination, explicitly modeling numerical precision, and incorporating hardware efficiency into generation. The code is available at https://github.com/BonnieW05/KernelBenchX

papers.title: AxMoE: Characterizing the Impact of Approximate Multipliers on Mixture-of-Experts DNN Architectures
papers.abstract: Deep neural network (DNN) inference at the edge demands simultaneous improvements in accuracy, computational efficiency, and energy consumption. Approximate computing and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have each been studied as independent routes towards efficient inference, the former by replacing exact arithmetic with low-power approximate multipliers, the latter by routing inputs through specialized expert sub-networks to enable conditional computation. However, their interaction remains entirely unexplored. This paper presents AxMoE, the first study of the impact of approximate multiplication on MoE DNN architectures. We evaluate three MoE variants: Hard MoE, Soft MoE, and Cluster MoE against dense baselines across three CNN architectures (ResNet-20, VGG11_bn, VGG19_bn) on CIFAR-100 and a Vision Transformer (ViT-Small) on Tiny ImageNet-200 dataset, using eight 8-bit signed multipliers (including one exact baseline) from the EvoApproxLib library. Results show that, without retraining, the Dense baseline is the most resilient topology across all CNN architectures, whereas on ViT-Small, all topologies degrade at comparable rates regardless of routing strategy. After approximate-aware retraining, recovery varies substantially across architectures, topologies, and multipliers. ResNet-20 achieves full recovery across the entire multiplier range, whereas VGG architectures recover at moderate multipliers but fail irreversibly at aggressive ones for all topologies except Cluster MoE on VGG11_bn; on ViT-Small, Hard MoE outperforms Dense under aggressive approximation at equal normalized inference cost. These results pave the way for future approximate MoE hardware-software co-design strategies.

digest.summaryZh: Energon 面向编码器 Transformer 的 PNM 推理映射，以 XY 对齐流水布局配合细粒度划分，联合优化网络分区与流水布局，并分别考虑无严格时延要求和给定时延上界的吞吐目标。

digest.summaryZh: 该文研究注意力加速器中的隐蔽硬件木马，使用 Adaptable Butterfly Transformer 加速器评估精度破坏，并初步检查 CNN 与脉动阵列设计。其价值在威胁与验证，不是推理加速收益。
digest.motivationZh: Transformer 加速器依赖正确硬件执行，但相对软件后门，硬件层恶意修改的模型精度影响受到较少关注。仅验证模型或训练数据不能排除硬件被篡改，需要研究专用加速器结构上的攻击影响。专用数据通路的正确性与安全性同样决定部署可信度，吞吐与面积评估之外还需关注故障传播。与用户设计矩阵/注意力核心有关，可补充硬件可信与验证视角；不属于主要的带宽或算力优化路线。
digest.methodZh: 硬件安全研究构造并评估三类木马，在选定注意力加速器受害设计上观察其精度影响。；注意力加速器硬件威胁分析；三类硬件木马评估；改变木马数量观察精度影响；CNN和脉动阵列的初步扩展；把关注点从软件后门移向注意力硬件结构，并跨若干加速器类别初步检验影响。
digest.experimentsZh: 选定 Transformer 加速器评测，附 CNN 和 systolic-array 设计初探；模型和数据集未在摘要披露。 受害设计及不同木马数量的对照；未披露检测器、无木马精度或完整配置。 亚利桑那大学机构摘要报告随木马数量变化出现 5%–91% 的准确率下降；未明确相对降幅或百分点口径，因此保持原文百分比表述。 仅有机构公开摘要和作者出版记录，未读设计及评测正文；不能复核隐蔽性、面积/功耗开销和检测难度，也不能把该降幅推广到所有 AI 加速器。

papers.title: HAIMA: A Hybrid SRAM and DRAM Accelerator-in-Memory Architecture for Transformer
papers.matchedQuery: transformer accelerator architecture
matchedQueries: transformer accelerator architecture
papers.relevanceReason: 命中 AI 处理器、体系结构、量化、训推系统或内存/缓存优化主题

digest.summaryZh: HAIMA面向Transformer推理中矩阵乘法引发的数据搬移瓶颈，将SRAM与DRAM两类AIM协同用于不同MMMO，并配套并行数据流。作者称相对Newton、TransPIM实现1.4-1.5倍加速，重点解决DRAM-AIM在轻量矩阵乘法上的资源低利用。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是Transformer类大规模深度网络推理中MMMO使数据搬移开销超过计算开销。重要性在于嵌入式/边缘场景受延迟、带宽和资源利用约束，单纯DRAM内计算不一定高效。已有Newton、TransPIM等AIMA未区分Transformer层间并行度和资源需求差异，导致轻量MMMO在DRAM-AIMA上资源低利用、推理延迟升高。该问题直接对应用户关注的PIM、存储层次和Transformer加速器架构。
digest.methodZh: 这是硬件/体系结构与数据流协同设计。核心是HAIMA混合SRAM与DRAM accelerator-in-memory架构，把不同类型的Transformer矩阵-矩阵乘法映射到更合适的SRAM-AIM或DRAM-AIM，并用并行数据流组织执行。可读摘要未披露具体层级划分规则、阵列规模、数据布局和调度细节，因此方法新意可确认的是异构AIM协同而非单一DRAM PIM。
digest.experimentsZh: 可读来源只披露与Newton和TransPIM对比，指标为推理速度/延迟改善与资源利用；作者报告硬件-软件协同设计达到1.4-1.5倍加速，并缓解DRAM-AIMA执行轻量MMMO时的资源低利用。摘要/PDF可读部分未披露模型名称、序列长度、芯片制程、面积、能耗、频率和完整工作负载设置。
digest.affiliationsZh: CoLab条目显示作者单位为 Hunan University, College of Information Science and Engineering, China；DBLP/daily元数据未提供作者单位。
digest.researchFitZh: 高度贴合用户的AI处理器、PIM/近存计算、Transformer推理和存储层次研究方向，是值得看架构细节的数据流型论文。
digest.whyReadZh: 值得继续读，因为它把Transformer层间异构性和SRAM/DRAM混合AIM联系起来；若能拿到PDF，应重点看MMMO分类、映射策略和资源利用分析。
digest.limitationsZh: 本地无PDF；可读网页仅有摘要级证据，缺少模型、负载、面积、能耗、频率、制程和完整baseline表。

digest.summaryZh: Helios 面向 Transformer 推理设计 FP16 端到端 FPGA 执行核心，以专用线性/非线性单元和多粒度调度组成单设备核心，再用高带宽互联支持多 FPGA 的流水与张量并行。
digest.motivationZh: Transformer 模型扩展增加计算、内存容量及系统规模需求，单 FPGA 与过度依赖低精度量化可能限制适用性。需要兼顾 FP16 数值路径、线性与非线性覆盖以及跨设备扩展，而不是只优化单个算子或低精度矩阵吞吐。多设备推理收益取决于执行单元和通信调度配合，端到端支持是区别于孤立算子加速的重要条件。直接涉及用户关注的矩阵/非线性单元、FPGA 数据通路和 Transformer 系统扩展，值得核对核心本地存储及通信设计。
digest.methodZh: 这是 FPGA 体系结构与调度设计，以 FP16 执行核心配合分布式多加速器互联。；线性与非线性专用硬件单元；多粒度调度；跨FPGA高带宽互联；流水并行和张量并行；把数值通用性较强的 FP16 端到端执行与多 FPGA 并行放在同一架构中，降低对激进量化的依赖。

digest.summaryZh: DRViT是面向Vision Transformer边缘推理的算法-架构协同FPGA加速器。它用动态token merging、token pruning和INT8量化削减冗余计算，并设计专用模块承接不规则模式；在Alveo U250上ViT-tiny达到0.86ms/image和1380GOP/s峰值。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是ViT在多模态/边缘场景中计算和存储需求高，尤其MHSA的Q/K/V在线生成、高维多头张量、LayerNorm/Softmax/GELU等非线性浮点操作以及低数据复用带来高延迟和能耗。已有轻量化算法会产生动态不规则token模式，若架构不能感知冗余和调度不规则性，就难以把算法收益变成硬件吞吐和能效。该问题与用户关注的Transformer/NPU加速、硬件友好量化和软硬件协同相关。
digest.methodZh: 这是算法-架构协同的FPGA系统。算法侧用动态token merging、token pruning和INT8量化减少ViT冗余计算与浮点非线性；架构侧设计动态冗余感知的专用数据流和模块，包括Token Merging and Pruning Module、Integer-Only Nonlinear Function Module、SLR Management Module等，将不规则token处理转化为可流式执行的硬件流程。新意在于同时处理token动态稀疏和整数化非线性，而不是只做静态量化或矩阵阵列。
digest.experimentsZh: 实现于Xilinx Alveo U250，使用Vivado 2020.1/2022.1，运行ViT-tiny/ImageNet并与CPU、GPU及其他FPGA加速器比较。报告140MHz下0.86ms/image、100MHz下1.17ms/image，峰值吞吐1380GOP/s，较以往SOTA提升2.24×。预览未完整披露所有baseline名称、准确率损失和能耗具体数值。

papers.title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
papers.abstract: Business process automation runs the same Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) again and again on new inputs. Large Language Model (LLM) agents can follow an SOP written in natural language, but they call an LLM to choose every step of every run, which adds latency and cost at scale. We present ReTrace, which turns an SOP and a few logged agent runs into a reusable workflow in which code, not an LLM, selects the next step. The agent's reasoning, the explanation it writes with each tool call, often states why it took an action; the tool calls alone do not. ReTrace extracts the condition behind each step, merges these conditions across runs into a compact rule document, and generates an executable workflow from it. Only this last stage depends on the platform, so rule documents can be compiled for different orchestration platforms. On $79$ procedures from our production platform, ReTrace workflows reach $93.8\%$ completion, against $96.8\%$ for the agent, at $24\%$ lower cost per task. On $τ^2$-Bench, they reach $75.8\%$ task success (agent: $80.6\%$) and run in $1.3$s instead of $170$s; three rounds of repair on training failures lift $k{=}2$ workflows from $66.7\%$ to $81.2\%$. On eight SOP-Bench procedures, ReTrace without repair trails few-shot generation ($80.6\%$ vs. $83.6\%$), but repair from labeled training failures lifts it to $87.8\%$ at $0.40$s per task, compared to $85.5\%$ in $46.6$s for the agent.

digest.summaryZh: ReTrace 从 SOP 与少量带解释的工具调用轨迹提取条件规则，再编译为可复用流程，由代码决定下一步，降低重复规划开销。planner-free 只排除规划调用，工具内部仍可能使用模型。
digest.motivationZh: 企业 SOP 在新输入上反复执行时，每一步都让 LLM 决策会累积延迟与调用成本。仅记录工具调用难以恢复动作条件和未走分支，单纯复用轨迹也无法覆盖可执行控制逻辑。把稳定流程的控制路径编译一次，有机会把模型留给确需语义判断的工具，减少重复推理。与智能体系统效率及工作负载结构有关，可辅助判断哪些开销需要芯片优化、哪些可由消除模型调用避免；不是新的加速器设计。
digest.methodZh: 系统与编译流程从推理解释中提取动作条件，跨轨迹汇总规则中间表示，再生成并检查代码或工作流图。；步骤级条件与输入来源提取；结合SOP合并有证据的规则；标记未实际执行的分支；生成可执行流程并禁止规划调用；用训练失败进行修复；利用动作解释中的条件与替代分支，而非仅按调用序列复放；平台依赖集中于最终合成阶段。
digest.experimentsZh: 79 个内部流程、τ²-Bench 和八个 SOP-Bench 流程，含训练反馈修复；正文核对工具模拟和成本口径。 原始工具智能体、零/少样本流程生成、execution-only、AWM 等；不同方案是否保留运行时规划需区分。 内部完成率 93.8% 对智能体 96.8%，成本低 24%；τ²-Bench 成功率 75.8% 对 80.6%，时间 1.3s 对170s。SOP-Bench 修复后 87.8%，对智能体85.5%；不能混同未修复与修复结果。 公开基准无模型调用的速度来自模拟工具与规划消除，不能外推真实 API 时延。正文内部中位数时间下降但均值上升，故不能声称企业所有任务都更快；对少样本等差异部分不显著，构建与修复成本还需摊销。

papers.matchedQuery: processing in memory transformer
matchedQueries: processing in memory transformer
papers.relevanceReason: 命中 AI 处理器、体系结构、量化、训推系统或内存/缓存优化主题

digest.summaryZh: Pimba面向Mamba-2、线性注意力、RNN等post-transformer LLM与传统Transformer的统一服务瓶颈，提出GPU+PIM加速方案。其SPU跨两个bank共享，SPE采用MX8量化算术执行状态更新和注意力，报告相对GPU/GPU+PIM提升生成吞吐并降低能耗。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是长上下文LLM服务中Transformer注意力和post-transformer状态更新都会在batch推理下受内存带宽限制。重要性在于SSM、linear attention、RNN等新模型被用于降低长序列成本，但服务系统需要同时支持新旧模型。已有PIM多聚焦attention/GEMV；post-transformer状态更新包含逐元素乘加、点积等多种原语，逐bank PIM面积成本高，且低精度格式会影响持续状态更新准确性。该问题正中用户关注的LLM推理系统、PIM、KV/状态存储和硬件友好量化。
digest.methodZh: 这是PIM体系结构、低精度算术和GPU-PIM系统协同设计。Pimba将状态更新与attention offload到PIM，其他操作交给GPU；核心硬件是每两个bank共享一个State-update Processing Unit，内部SPE含MX8量化的向量乘法器和加法器，用交错访问读写不同bank的row buffer。系统还包含自定义DRAM命令与调度，支持状态预充和生成期计算。新意在于把post-transformer状态更新作为一等公民，而非只优化Transformer attention。
digest.experimentsZh: 评估覆盖Mamba-2、GLA、RetNet、HGRN2、Zamba2和OPT，比较GPU、GPU+Q、GPU+PIM、NeuPIMs/HBM-PIM等，指标包括生成吞吐、状态更新/attention延迟、能耗、准确率和面积。可读全文报告状态更新延迟较GPU/GPU+PIM低14.6×/6.9×，attention低6.3×/1.8×，能耗平均较GPU/GPU+PIM低2.2×/1.2×，面积开销13.4%。吞吐结果网页摘要与全文存在3.2×/4.1×相对GPU的不一致，但均报告相对GPU+PIM最高2.1×。
digest.affiliationsZh: 全文首页显示Wonung Kim、Yubin Lee、Yoonsung Kim、Jinwoo Hwang、Seongryong Oh、Jiyong Jung、Aziz Huseynov、Woong Gyu Park、Jongse Park为KAIST；Chang Hyun Park为Uppsala University；Divya Mahajan为Georgia Institute of Technology。
digest.researchFitZh: 非常贴合用户主线：它同时涉及LLM推理服务、PIM近存计算、post-transformer架构、低精度算术和GPU-PIM系统边界。
digest.whyReadZh: 应深读，尤其关注状态更新roofline、SPU跨bank共享的面积/吞吐权衡、MX8对连续状态更新准确率的影响，以及与attention PIM系统的兼容方式。

motivationDetail.gapZh: 既有LLM PIM系统主要针对attention/GEMV，不能高效支持状态更新；逐bank实现状态更新硬件面积过高。

methodDetail.hardwareSystemDetailZh: SPU交错访问两个bank的row buffer以维持吞吐并控制面积；PIM执行状态更新和attention，GPU处理其他层；使用MX8量化和随机舍入缓解连续状态更新精度损失。

digest.summaryZh: RoPIM针对Transformer中RoPE在推理阶段的高开销，提出bank-level PIM架构。它在内存侧支持乘加、并行数据重排，并用bank/row级数据映射减少bank间通信和DRAM激活；摘要报告RoPE占GPU时间61%，RoPIM最高307.9×性能提升和914.1×能耗节省。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是RoPE虽能在长序列中有效注入位置信息且无需重训，但推理时会因大量数据搬移和执行依赖成为瓶颈。作者观察RoPE占GPU执行时间61%。已有常规GPU/系统在处理RoPE这类位置编码算子时需要频繁搬移数据，长上下文下开销更突出。该问题与用户关注的LLM推理、长上下文内存层次、PIM和Transformer专用算子加速高度相关。
digest.methodZh: 这是面向RoPE算子的PIM硬件架构。RoPIM使用bank-level accelerator，在内存附近支持multiply-add操作以减少片外搬移；通过并行数据重排降低RoPE操作依赖；再用bank-level和row-level数据映射实现并行执行、消除bank-to-bank通信并减少DRAM activations。新意在于把通常被当作小算子的RoPE单独作为PIM加速对象，并围绕其旋转/重排模式设计数据映射。
digest.experimentsZh: 可读摘要只披露与conventional systems对比，指标为性能和能耗；结果为最高307.9×性能提升、914.1×能耗节省，并指出RoPE在GPU上占执行时间61%。摘要/PDF可读部分未披露具体Transformer模型、序列长度、GPU型号、PIM仿真配置、面积开销和平均结果。
digest.affiliationsZh: DGIST Pure条目列出Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science、Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute of Science and Technology以及Samsung；Yonsei页面还列出School of System & Semiconductor Engineering。具体作者到机构的映射未完全披露。
digest.researchFitZh: 非常贴合LLM推理内存层次与PIM方向，尤其适合关注长上下文位置编码、数据重排和近存算子加速的人继续读。
digest.whyReadZh: 应深读，因为它把RoPE这种通常不被单独建模的推理算子量化为主要GPU瓶颈，并给出bank/row级PIM映射策略。
digest.limitationsZh: IEEE CAL篇幅短且本地无PDF；可读摘要未披露完整实验设置、平均性能、面积和可扩展性边界。

digest.summaryZh: SAL-PIM是面向GPT类文本生成的HBM PIM架构，针对generation阶段逐token迭代、整模型反复读取且数据复用低的问题，把S-ALU放到subarray附近、用LUT线性插值处理非线性，并在HBM buffer die加入C-ALU完成跨bank归约。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是decoder-only GPT文本生成分为可并行summarization和难加速的sequential generation；generation每轮生成一个token且需要读取完整模型，数据复用少，使外部内存带宽成为系统瓶颈。已有GPU/常规加速器难以缓解反复权重读取和非线性函数开销。该问题对用户的LLM推理、HBM/PIM、内存带宽和端到端生成系统研究高度相关。
digest.methodZh: 这是HBM-based subarray-level PIM架构。SAL-PIM在memory subarray旁集成多个S-ALU以利用HBM内部带宽，并针对不同操作设计数据映射；为降低S-ALU面积，利用同bank命令慢时钟共享MAC；在bank内若干subarray作为LUT，通过多地址选择区间做线性插值以处理非线性函数；在HBM buffer die加入C-ALU执行跨bank accumulation和reduce-sum，目标是端到端在PIM中完成Transformer文本生成。
digest.experimentsZh: 作者基于Ramulator构建cycle-accurate simulator，并实现SAL-PIM逻辑单元于28nm CMOS后缩放到DRAM工艺验证可行性。工作负载为GPT-2 medium 345M，输入token 32-128、输出token 1-256；baseline为Nvidia Titan RTX GPU运行Faster Transformer。结果显示4.81%面积开销下，最高4.72×、平均1.83×加速。
digest.affiliationsZh: KAIST Pure条目显示作者单位为Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, School of Electrical Engineering。
digest.researchFitZh: 非常贴合LLM推理系统、HBM/PIM、近存非线性函数和内存带宽优化，是用户主线内值得深读的架构论文。
digest.whyReadZh: 应深读，重点看S-ALU/C-ALU划分、LUT线性插值精度/面积权衡、GPT generation数据映射和端到端PIM边界。
digest.limitationsZh: 实验模型为GPT-2 medium，未从摘要确认更大LLM或KV cache现代长上下文设置；需看全文确认准确率影响、LUT误差和可扩展性。

motivationDetail.gapZh: 常规GPU和非端到端PIM难以同时处理线性层、非线性函数和跨bank归约。
motivationDetail.whyImportantZh: 文本生成是LLM服务核心路径，带宽瓶颈直接限制吞吐和能效。
motivationDetail.userRelevanceZh: 直接对应LLM推理、HBM/近存计算、非线性算子硬件化和内存层次设计。

matchedQueries: LLM inference accelerator

digest.summaryZh: 该文面向低比特LLM推理提出量化算法与bit-level加速器协同设计。算法将权重细分为cluster，显式考虑outlier和salient point并保护重要权重；硬件采用内存对齐编码和并行bit-level计算，摘要报告较ANT、OliVe、FineQ均有速度和能效提升。
digest.motivationZh: 问题是LLM推理同时受巨大计算量和模型内存占用限制，超低权重量化能减小带宽/容量压力，但会带来准确率下降和混合精度硬件执行复杂。已有量化方法对outlier、salient weights和组内分布处理不足，现有加速器也不一定能高效执行灵活低比特表示。该问题与用户关注的硬件友好量化、LLM推理加速、bit-level accelerator和软硬件协同高度相关。
digest.methodZh: 这是低比特量化算法与硬件加速器协同设计。算法侧先把权重划成小cluster，做fine-grained intra-cluster bit allocation，显式考虑每个cluster内outlier和salient point分布；再用intra-cluster protection选择性保留重要权重，并引入extended integer format和group-wise scale factor search降低激进降bit导致的精度损失。系统侧设计memory-aligned encoding支持高效访存和混合精度识别，硬件侧用轻量bit-level accelerator进行并行bit-level计算。
digest.experimentsZh: 摘要未披露具体LLM、任务、数据集、硬件平台和精度位宽分布；披露对比对象为SOTA量化算法以及ANT、OliVe、FineQ加速器。算法在超低权重精度下取得更高模型准确率；硬件相对ANT、OliVe、FineQ分别实现1.59×、1.38×、1.61×加速，以及1.52×、1.42×、1.22×能效提升。
digest.affiliationsZh: DBLP/daily元数据未提供；ResearchGate显示Liang Wang为Beihang University，Xiaojian Liao主页显示其为Beihang University，不能据此可靠确认全体作者单位。
digest.researchFitZh: 高度贴合硬件友好量化与LLM推理加速方向，尤其适合比较bit-serial/bit-level计算与混合精度编码的架构代价。
digest.whyReadZh: 值得深读，重点看cluster内bit分配、重要权重保护、memory-aligned encoding如何映射到bit-level硬件，以及与ANT/OliVe/FineQ的公平性。
digest.limitationsZh: 可读来源为摘要级，缺少模型列表、数据集、准确率表、位宽配置、硬件面积/频率/制程和端到端系统设置。

motivationDetail.problemZh: LLM推理计算和内存占用大，超低比特量化需要同时保持准确率和硬件效率。
motivationDetail.gapZh: 已有方法对cluster内部outlier/salient point和混合精度硬件识别支持不足。
motivationDetail.whyImportantZh: 低比特权重能直接降低LLM推理带宽与存储压力，但若硬件不能高效执行则无法兑现收益。

methodDetail.hardwareSystemDetailZh: 硬件侧支持并行bit-level computation，编码侧保证访存对齐并能灵活识别mixed-precision representation；摘要未披露PE阵列、buffer层次和面积。

digest.motivationZh: LLM迁移到新加速器时，算子不支持、编译断图和后端数值分歧难以定位，重复人工调试耗时。需要跨模型、跨torch.compile后端复用的错误定位和最小复现工具。新芯片能否运行真实LLM，取决于软件使能与数值排错效率。适合新NPU软件栈验证与逐层误差诊断，研究对象是调试系统而非新芯片核心。

papers.title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.

digest.summaryZh: 论文提出Sensorimotor Alignment（S²），用训练自由的离线指标衡量机器人基础模型的视觉/文本感知表示与未来物理运动轨迹几何结构是否一致。S²在VLA、原始VLM、World Action Model和真实机器人策略上都与任务成功率呈正相关，可用于昂贵闭环评估前的模型筛选。
digest.motivationZh: 机器人基础模型通常必须通过昂贵的闭环rollout评估真实任务成功率，而VQA分数或视频质量指标并不能稳定预测具身控制效果。作者基于Platonic Representation Hypothesis提出问题：更强模型的感知表示是否会更贴近物理运动结构，从而形成可廉价计算、与下游成功率相关的离线代理指标。
digest.methodZh: S²从每个episode抽取图像与文本经过模型编码器得到的感知embedding，同时提取后续h步末端执行器位置、姿态与夹爪状态构成运动轨迹；方法比较感知空间与运动空间的局部邻域几何一致性，形成训练自由的alignment score。它不修改模型参数，而是用表示层结构衡量模型是否把任务相关物理运动组织进感知表示。
digest.experimentsZh: 实验覆盖12个VLA、8个原始VLM backbone、6个World Action Model以及5个真实机器人策略。12个VLA上S²与SimplerEnv成功率的Pearson r为+0.717；8个VLM的S²与后续VLA成功率r为+0.681，而VQA分数为-0.154；5个真实机器人策略上r为+0.831。论文还比较FID、SSIM、PSNR等视频质量指标并做鲁棒性与表征层消融。
digest.affiliationsZh: Yunfei Xie、Howard H. Qian、Kaiyu Hang：Rice University；Shiyi Lan：NVIDIA；Chen Wei：未在 DBLP/arXiv 元数据中提供
digest.researchFitZh: 属于具身智能与世界模型的算法评估趋势，对用户的Agent/多模态趋势跟踪有价值；与LLM推理芯片和计算核心没有直接硬件关系。
digest.whyReadZh: 值得作为具身/世界模型评估方法浏览，尤其可了解如何用离线表征指标替代昂贵闭环测试；但不需要按芯片论文深读。
digest.limitationsZh: S²主要证明相关性而非因果性，且相关系数基于有限模型数量；不同机器人、任务、参考数据和embodiment不匹配时可能削弱预测能力。

motivationDetail.problemZh: 闭环机器人评估成本高，而常见VQA或视频质量指标无法可靠预测具身策略真实任务成功率。
motivationDetail.gapZh: 缺少一种无需训练、能直接反映感知表征是否包含物理运动结构的通用离线代理指标。
motivationDetail.whyImportantZh: 若能在微调或真实机器人测试前筛掉弱模型，可明显减少具身模型开发中的闭环评测成本。
motivationDetail.userRelevanceZh: 与用户关注的Agent、世界模型和多模态趋势相关，但不属于AI处理器计算核心研究。

papers.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

papers.title: When Human Corrections Travel: Safety in Federated VLA Adaptation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can adapt to local human intervention, while federated learning can combine distributed robot experience without pooling raw records. We examine their prospective intersection: sharing adaptations derived from diverse human corrections across tasks, environments, people, and robot embodiments. Corrections differ in modality, safety semantics(urgency, behavioral scope, etc.), and privacy sensitivity. A shared update that improves mean task success may suppress a rare safety intervention or produce an unsafe response on another robot. We argue for three requirements: preserve the context and uncertainty of multimodal corrections when deciding what to share; assess candidate updates in each receiving robot's closed loop before deployment; and evaluate leakage alongside retention of safety-critical evidence. Immediate, legible defensive behavior remains necessary during human interaction. We offer counterexamples and a falsifiable evaluation agenda, not experimental results.

papers.title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
papers.abstract: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.

papers.title: OopsieRecover: Learning Transferable VLA Corrections from Semantic Interventions
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform a wide range of robotic manipulation tasks, but often fail during deployment. Teaching them to recover from these failures requires substantial corrective data: existing approaches learn to recover from failures by directly associating corrective actions with the observations in which they were demonstrated. For instance, DAgger-like fine-tuning can require tens to hundreds of interactions, yet the resulting policy may still fail to generalize the learned corrections beyond the demonstrated scenarios. We hypothesize that semantics can capture the underlying reasons for failures and their corrections, enabling policies to learn from only a handful of corrective demonstrations and generalize those corrections to novel objects, and scene variations. We propose OopsieRecover, a framework that uses abduction to infer the intent behind a small set of corrective demonstrations and encodes the inferred knowledge as dense spatial representations and conditional costs. These costs capture when a behavior is undesirable and steer the policy toward more desirable action regions. We experiment across 6 tasks and variations in object poses, scenes, and related tasks, and find that only a handful of corrective demonstrations can enable a VLA to overcome failures across a broad range of novel situations, without requiring new corrective data for each variation. Please refer to https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsierecover for videos.

papers.title: ConsisVLA-4D: Advancing Spatiotemporal Consistency in Efficient 3D-Perception and 4D-Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models primarily focus on mapping 2D observations to actions, but exhibit notable limitations in spatiotemporal perception and reasoning: 1) spatial representations often rely on additional sensors, introducing substantial computational overhead; 2) visual reasoning is typically limited to future-frame prediction, lacking alignment with the instruction-grounded scene and thus compromising spatiotemporal consistency. To address these challenges, we propose ConsisVLA-4D, a unified and efficient framework that enhances spatiotemporal consistency in 3D perception and 4D reasoning. Specifically, we design: 1) CV-Aligner, which ensures cross-view object semantic consistency by filtering instruction-relevant regions and aligning object identities across multiple viewpoints; 2) CO-Fuser, which guarantees cross-object spatial geometric consistency by eliminating spatial relation ambiguities between objects across views using compact latent representations. Building upon these, we introduce 3) CS-Thinker to achieve cross-scene spatiotemporal consistency as actions unfold. It learns implicit knowledge of local dynamics from object-semantic tokens of CV-Aligner and global depth from geometric tokens of CO-Fuser, thereby enhancing efficient visual reasoning under scene variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, benefiting from its efficient spatiotemporal consistency design, ConsisVLA-4D achieves 21.6% and 41.5% performance improvements, along with 2.3-fold and 2.4-fold inference speedups compared to OpenVLA on the LIBERO benchmark and real-world platforms, respectively.ConsisVLA-4D is open-sourced and publicly available at

papers.title: Enhancing Language Model Reasoning with Structured Multi-Level Modeling
papers.abstract: Inference-time scaling enhances a model's reasoning by extending its chain-of-thought (CoT). However, existing approaches typically rely on a single policy trained with outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL), which often suffers from long-horizon plan failures where the implicit plan drifts from valid strategies, especially for small LMs with limited capacity. To address this, we propose Multi-Level Reasoning (MLR), which reformulates long-CoT generation as a two-level stochastic process. A high-level planner generates structured step descriptors specifying both the reasoning mode and the semantic subgoal. The low-level executor then produces detailed reasoning conditioned on these descriptors, forming an alternating plan--execute loop. To maintain scalability, we adopt a minimal design where the base model serves as the low-level policy and a lightweight LoRA module implements the high-level policy. For training, we observe that outcome-reward RL provides sparse and delayed feedback for long trajectories (e.g., several thousand tokens), hindering credit assignment. We therefore introduce iterative Step-DPO, a process-level preference optimization scheme that leverages Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo (TSMC) to provide scalable stepwise supervision. This yields more effective training, improved stability, and higher accuracy. Extensive experiments on challenging math, science, and logical reasoning benchmarks show that, under the same reduced data budget (10% SFT and 5% preference relative to the DeepSeek-R1 distillation setup), MLR outperforms both SFT-based distillation and strong RL/preference-optimization baselines across multiple base models and tasks. Moreover, MLR exhibits slower performance degradation on long-horizon reasoning, demonstrating stronger robustness under extended CoT generation.

papers.title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
papers.abstract: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don't appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

papers.title: Represented but Not Used: Value-Policy Dissociation in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents need to choose actions whose consequences unfold over multiple future steps, yet poor decisions do not reveal whether the model failed to represent those consequences or failed to use them. Mechanistic interpretability has studied internal representations of environment state and plans, but sequential decision making also requires evaluating how candidate actions change future outcomes. Reinforcement learning formalizes this as action value. We study this computation in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, and GPT-OSS-20B across a partially observed Grid environment and WebShop, a simulated web shopping environment. We find that the relative values of candidate actions are linearly decodable from intermediate hidden states, including at states where the policy prefers a worse action. We call this gap between value representation and policy choice value-policy dissociation. To investigate how represented value relates to action selection, we compare direct interventions along the value readout direction with Natural Value Transport (NVT), a transformation learned from hidden state changes that naturally result from differences in action value. While readout-direction interventions have limited and inconsistent effects, NVT more consistently influences action preferences, particularly at later layers. We also test a closed-loop controller that uses the value readout as a sensor and NVT as an actuator, observing improvements in task outcomes. These results suggest that LLM agents can represent useful prospective value without reliably translating it into policy choice.

digest.motivationZh: Agent选择错误动作可能源于未表示未来后果，也可能源于未利用已形成的价值信息。仅观察最终行为或线性探针准确率，不能说明价值表示是否能因果影响策略。区分表示与使用有助于定位多步决策失效环节和设计有针对性的控制。属于Agent机制解释与决策算法趋势，对硬件架构只有间接工作负载意义。
digest.methodZh: 从中间状态学习相对动作价值读出，比较沿读出方向的直接干预与自然价值变化学习出的NVT变换。线性探针评估价值排序。NVT学习自然隐藏状态差分。闭环控制以读出为传感器、NVT为执行器。这是隐藏状态分析与干预算法；本轮证据没有支持其带来芯片吞吐、显存或能耗节约。将价值可读性与策略可控性分离，并用自然表示变化构造干预而非仅沿线性读出方向移动。
digest.experimentsZh: Qwen2.5-7B/32B-Instruct与GPT-OSS-20B，测试部分可观察Grid和模拟WebShop。比较原策略、价值读出方向干预与NVT；本轮未逐项核对全部控制消融数值。摘要报告较差决策状态仍可读出正确的相对价值；直接读出方向干预效果有限且不稳定，NVT尤其在后层更一致改变偏好，闭环控制改善任务结果；不补写未核对的提升数值。价值标签为任务特定构造，线性可读不证明模型实际采用相同价值计算；受限环境结果不能泛化为通用Agent控制保证。

papers.title: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
papers.abstract: We consider online monitoring of an AI system that produces a sequence of decisions. At each round, the system outputs a proposed decision together with a confidence score estimating the trustworthiness of the decision. The decision and confidence score need not be produced by the same model: for example, one agent may propose a decision, while a separate verifier agent evaluates it and outputs a correctness or safety score. Based on this information, we must decide whether to accept the AI decision automatically or consult an expert, such as a human auditor, who reviews the proposal and either accepts or corrects it. We formulate this task as an online constrained optimization problem in which the goal is to minimize the frequency of expert auditing while guaranteeing that the fraction of AI errors that go unaudited stays below a user-defined threshold. We derive a family of algorithms with provable error-control guarantees with no assumptions, including a method that is optimally efficient: it asymptotically attains the best achievable auditing rate for both adversarial and i.i.d. data streams. Experiments on screening harmful requests to large language models, qualitative text annotation, and data labeling show that our methods achieve valid error control in practice while substantially reducing the need for human auditing compared to baselines.

digest.summaryZh: 论文研究AI决策的选择性审计：系统为每个自动决策提供置信度，算法只把部分低可信或风险较高样本交给专家，同时约束未被审计的AI错误比例不超过用户设定阈值。作者给出自适应阈值、置信度校准和渐近最优审计算法，并在安全审核、文本编码和数据标注上验证。
digest.motivationZh: 在AI辅助决策中，全部交给人工审核成本高，完全自动化又会留下不可接受的错误；同时模型置信度可能失准，且数据流可能是非独立甚至对抗性的。因此需要在线选择哪些决策必须人工审计，在尽量减少专家工作量的同时，对“错误逃过审计”的比例给出明确且可证明的控制保证。
digest.methodZh: 作者把问题写成在线约束优化：每轮观察AI决策及置信分数，决定自动接受还是调用专家。基础算法维护一个随已观察错误加减更新的阈值，置信度低于阈值时审计；进一步加入置信度再校准，并提出optimally efficient selective auditing，使长期审计率逼近在给定错误约束下可达到的最优水平，同时扩展到批处理和其他错误指标。
digest.experimentsZh: 应用实验覆盖LLM安全审核、质性文本编码和四类数据标注任务。安全实验使用SORRY-Bench 7040条样本和StrongREJECT 1361条样本，以GPT-5.4自一致性8次判断形成置信度，并与随机审计及事后oracle阈值比较；各方法在SORRY-Bench上把错误率控制在目标附近，校准阈值和最优方法节省的审计工作多于基础加性阈值。其他任务也显示最优方法通常获得更高审计节省。
digest.affiliationsZh: Isaac Gibbs：University of Toronto；Elise L. Han：Stanford University；Ryan J. Tibshirani：University of California, Berkeley；Tijana Zrnic：Stanford University
digest.researchFitZh: 属于Agent/AI系统可靠性与人机协同算法，可为自动化Agent中的验证器和人工升级机制提供理论框架；与芯片计算核心本身没有直接联系。
digest.whyReadZh: 若设计高可靠Agent工作流或自动审核系统值得阅读，尤其是其“置信度+选择性人工复核”的控制框架；对当前NPU/GPU微架构主线属于次要趋势。
digest.limitationsZh: 理论保证针对论文定义的错误比例和反馈机制；真实部署中置信分数质量、人工审计延迟、分布漂移与高风险少数事件可能改变实际收益。

experimentDetail.mainResultsZh: SORRY-Bench上各方法错误率接近目标α，带校准的阈值和最优方法比基础阈值节省更多审核；StrongREJECT上两种高效方法略高于目标α。文本编码与标注任务中，最优方法通常更接近oracle的审核节省。

papers.title: BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories
papers.abstract: Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories (SDCLs) are moving chemical experimentation toward embodied automation, where machines must perceive laboratory scenes, reason about experimental states, and act under physical, procedural, and safety constraints. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as embodied brains for such systems, existing laboratory benchmarks mainly focus on safety, anomaly detection, or general scientific understanding, leaving their execution-oriented embodied capabilities underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BEAKER, a Benchmark for evaluating Embodied Actionability, Knowledge, Experimentation, and Reasoning in SDCLs. BEAKER contains 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types, covering key judgments required for chemical laboratory execution, including affordance grounding, trajectory planning, equipment, state, and safety recognition, apparatus setup, operation and step reasoning, and temporal procedure reasoning. All questions and annotations are manually created and reviewed by chemistry and embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts, without AI-assisted generation or annotation. We evaluate 28 general-purpose, science-oriented, chemistry-specialized, and embodied MLLMs in an offline, single-turn setting. Results show that current models can follow coarse experimental procedures in videos, but still struggle to ground actions into operable regions and feasible trajectories, to recognize fine-grained laboratory apparatus, states, and safety norms, and to order steps in mid-length procedures. BEAKER thus reveals a clear gap between coarse procedural understanding and the precise, action-grounded perception required for laboratory execution, providing a diagnostic benchmark for future MLLMs in SDCLs.

papers.title: Words Caught in the Heart: Simulating Person-Specific Expression for Self-Opaque Clients in Psychotherapy
papers.abstract: Psychotherapy clients may experience distress before they can coherently describe it, and their expression changes with emotion, perceived safety, and trust. Large language model-based client simulators often rely on clinically organized case descriptions, which can encourage responses explaining the client's difficulties more clearly than their current understanding warrants. We propose Pandora, a psychotherapy client simulation framework that models how psychological experience becomes situated, individual expression. Pandora updates psychological and relational states in response to therapist interventions, constructs subjective appraisals and attributions, and plans response content and strategy. A separate expression planner combines these decisions with language patterns distilled from the client's utterances to guide linguistic realization. We evaluate Pandora against five baselines on 115 cases from four counseling and motivational interviewing datasets. It achieves the highest expression similarity and overall disclosure-alignment score among the compared systems. In a four-evaluator study of 45 matched disclosure items, Pandora receives AI-like judgments in 7.2% of ratings, compared with 43.3--67.2% for the baselines and 35.6% without expression planning. The ablation also reduces expression similarity. These results support explicit expression planning in client simulation to improve alignment with individual language patterns and reduce perceived AI-like expression in the evaluated setting.

papers.title: Manifold Steering Reveals the Shared Geometry of Neural Network Representation and Behavior
papers.abstract: Neural representations carry rich geometric structure; but does that structure causally shape behavior? To address this question, we intervene along paths through activation space defined by different geometries, and measure the behavioral trajectories they induce. In particular, we test whether interventions that respect the geometry of activation space will yield behaviors close to those the model exhibits naturally. Concretely, we first fit an activation manifold $M_h$ to representations and a behavior manifold $M_y$ to output probability distributions. We then test the link $M_h \leftrightarrow M_y$ via interventions: we find that steering along $M_h$, which we term manifold steering, yields behavioral trajectories that follow $M_y$, while linear steering -- which assumes a Euclidean geometry -- cuts through off-manifold regions and hence produces unnatural outputs. Moreover, optimizing interventions in activation space to produce paths along $M_y$ recovers activation trajectories that trace the curvature of $M_h$. We demonstrate this bidirectional relationship between the geometry of representation and behavior across tasks and modalities. In language models, we use reasoning tasks with cyclic and sequential geometries as well as in-context learning tasks with more complex graph geometries. In a video world model, we use a task with geometry corresponding to physical dynamics. Overall, our work shows that geometry in neural representation is not merely incidental, but is in fact the proper object for enabling principled control via intervention on internals. This recasts the core problem of steering from finding the right direction to finding the right geometry.

digest.summaryZh: Manifold Steering 研究神经网络 activation representation 的几何结构是否因果塑造行为：沿 activation manifold 干预会产生贴近 behavior manifold 的自然行为轨迹，而线性 steering 会穿过 off-manifold 区域并造成不自然输出。
digest.motivationZh: 神经表示通常具有复杂几何结构，但模型控制方法常把 steering 简化为欧氏空间中的方向选择；如果 representation geometry 与 behavior geometry 有因果对应，忽视流形曲率会让内部干预偏离模型自然行为。
digest.methodZh: 方法先分别拟合 activation manifold M_h 和 output probability distribution 的 behavior manifold M_y，再通过两类干预测试二者联系：沿 M_h 的 manifold steering 与假设欧氏几何的 linear steering 对比；反向还优化 activation intervention 以产生沿 M_y 的行为路径，检验是否恢复 M_h 曲率。
digest.experimentsZh: 摘要披露跨任务和模态验证：语言模型中包含 cyclic/sequential geometries 的 reasoning tasks 以及更复杂 graph geometries 的 in-context learning tasks；video world model 中使用对应物理动态几何的任务。结果是 manifold steering 的行为轨迹跟随 M_y，linear steering 产生 off-manifold 不自然输出。摘要未给具体模型、数据集、指标或数值。

papers.title: D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. Naive prompting of frontier models collapses into a binary success detector that fails to capture nuanced, non-linear progress and failures. While post-training approaches can mitigate this through explicit training, they demand expensive real-world robotics data and require computationally intensive post-training for every individual base model. To resolve these limitations, we introduce D&A (Describe & Assess): our approach decouples progress estimation into an objective, task-grounded textual description of scene dynamics followed by an assessment phase using explicit rubrics. By compelling the VLM to synthesize an explicit, text-based definition of absolute success before scoring, the framework anchors evaluations to an external, global criterion rather than the video's internal timeline. Empirical results demonstrate that our method calibrates zero-shot estimates and mitigates confirmation bias, providing fine-grained, partial progress metrics that accurately penalize failed executions while correctly interpolating successful runs. Being purely prompt-based, D&A generalizes across tasks, embodiments, and benchmarks---matching or surpassing post-trained reward models---and its reward estimates enable efficient downstream reinforcement learning.

papers.title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
papers.abstract: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.

papers.title: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
papers.abstract: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.

papers.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
papers.abstract: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.

papers.title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
papers.abstract: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. Meta access thus turns chat from a window onto one conversation into a control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without surrendering user control. As assistants become embedded in IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, AI-era interfaces should expose a structured, permissioned model of their state and capabilities, ideally by opening their existing metamodels through a debugger-like interface.

papers.title: Where LLM Agents Get Stuck Debugging Databases: Access More Than Reasoning
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents are increasingly asked not only to write code but to debug running systems from live runtime data. We report a field observation of one such agent (Claude Code) as it diagnosed eight database incidents in a production message-dispatch engine. In every incident whose root cause depended on runtime concurrency, the agent announced a cause, shipped a fix, and later walked it back, and each wrong guess cost a deploy-and-observe cycle. Mapping each incident to what the agent lacked, we find that access to production state was the most pervasive bottleneck. The missing access included live lock views, untruncated deadlock reports, read-only execution, and an explicit environment context. An access gap was present in all five concurrency-dependent incidents: alone in one, and in four combined with a reasoning error such as anchoring on an early cause, incomplete exploration of the configuration, or a misreading of the code's transaction semantics. The three incidents that did not depend on concurrency needed nothing beyond what the agent already had. Within the incidents, the agent's wrong hypotheses were consistent with the evidence it could see; they were not fabrications. We argue that the next step for production-debugging agents is a forensics layer that gives the agent the access it lacks inside existing security controls. Such a layer would combine a safe interrogation API, a lock-and-deadlock flight recorder, and a production replay harness.

papers.title: WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.

papers.title: Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games
papers.abstract: As large language models become more capable agents, they can exhibit deceptive behaviors, cheating human for higher rewards while appearing helpful. We attribute this failure to evaluation-side partial observability, where models are evaluated mainly from final outcome, without checking the faithfulness of underlying reasoning, tool use, and environmental effects. Prior mitigations address this partial observability by predefined evaluator latent belief space or one-shot monitoring, which do not extend to free-form language space and vulnerable to stronger deceptions that evade simple monitoring. In this work, we formulate deception mitigation as an Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Extensive Form Game (e-PoG), a max-min framework in which an agent maximizes reward, a monitor minimizes the agent's payoff by exposing deception from the full interaction trajectory, and a fixed verifier validates the monitor's claims and converts them into penalties. We define the solution concept as a Subgame-Perfect Oversight Equilibrium (SPOE) between agent and monitor, and prove its existence in finite games. With a perfect verifier, every SPOE is faithful; with an imperfect verifier, the guarantee persists if verifier errors do not reverse the ranking of monitor actions. To achieve faithful SPOE, we derive a two-timescale policy gradient algorithm and enhance the pipeline empirically with NLI verification and deterministic checks. Experiments with Gemma3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B/8B on Agentic Role-Playing, SearchQA, and WebShop show that e-PoG mitigates multiple emergent deception modes, outperforming the strongest baselines by 26.0% in deception mitigation and by up to 39.8% in task success. These gains persist under weak-to-strong supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent.

papers.title: DiSARM: Diverse and Surprising Association Rule Mining with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) aims to discover informative patterns in large datasets. For transactional data, Association Rule Mining (ARM) is an established approach that facilitates EDA by efficiently generating candidate patterns. Beyond efficient mining, identifying informative rules has also been extensively studied through both objective and subjective interestingness measures. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for assessing subjective interestingness using world knowledge. Nevertheless, relying solely on LLMs raises concerns about scalability and statistical reliability. Building on prior ARM research, we propose a hybrid framework, DiSARM, that leverages the world knowledge of LLMs to assess the subjective interestingness of rules, while maintaining statistical reliability and promoting diversity among the selected rules. Across three transactional datasets, experiments demonstrate that DiSARM effectively combines statistical reliability with surprise and diversity, offering a promising approach to ADE from transactional data.

papers.title: A Framework for Context Enrichment and Selective Robustness in LLM Social Agents
papers.abstract: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner's Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.

papers.title: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate detailed video captions, yet they may overemphasize minor details while overlooking essential context and key events. We argue that not all visual evidence deserves equal attention, as the importance of visual information depends on the content of each video. Motivated by this observation, we propose Reviso, an agentic video captioning framework that learns what to observe and how to gather relevant visual evidence. From a low-frame-rate global preview, Reviso constructs a hierarchical Context--Focus--Points (CFP) observation plan that identifies the video context, prioritizes key aspects, and defines concrete observation targets and corresponding tools. Guided by this plan, Reviso performs goal-directed active perception by selectively revisiting temporal segments and combining tools for fine-grained inspection. It interprets the acquired evidence, updates its plan as needed, and integrates global and local information to generate the final caption. To learn this observation strategy, we develop a verification-guided pipeline that constructs high-quality training trajectories through factual verification and teacher-guided refinement. We further train Reviso using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), incorporating a key-fact reward for caption quality, a Plan Alignment Reward (PAR) for identifying important observation targets, and an Unproductive Tool-Call Penalty (UTCP) that adjusts observation-cost penalties based on caption quality. Experiments across four video captioning benchmarks show that Reviso outperforms the evaluated open-source baselines, while its generated captions better support downstream video question answering. These findings highlight the effectiveness and potential of priority-guided active observation for video captioning.

papers.title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
papers.abstract: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another's work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.

papers.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.

papers.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
papers.abstract: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Tool-Use Agents via Controllable Environment Synthesis
papers.abstract: We explore how to build performant large language model (LLM) tool-use agents that complete complex, multi-step tasks. Specifically, we study how data composition in synthetically generated tool-use environments affects the training of such agents. To do so, we propose the SynthAPI pipeline, which explicitly controls the diversity of generated environments along the axes of tools, tasks, and the databases on which the tools operate. By systematically varying SynthAPI's generation controls in 458,752 tasks across 849 trained models of four different sizes, we derive a scaling law that predicts downstream tool-use agent generalization based on the scale and composition of the synthesized environments. These predictable relationships reveal several lessons for scaling tool-use agent data. As data budgets grow, scaling tool and database diversity becomes more effective than increasing the number of tasks, and increasing data complexity yields larger gains. Scaling according to these findings yields agents that outperform models trained on data from prior work in large-scale tool-use agent and synthetic environment generation across four evaluation benchmarks.
